title: Modernization Engagement Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

The largest modernization programs are often won or lost in the space between the deal and the delivery. They span applications, cloud, mainframe, and network & edge, involve many teams, and carry high expectations from day one. Clients need someone who keeps it all connected. As a Modernization Engagement Lead at Kyndryl, that someone is you.

You’ll lead coordination across sales, architects, consulting, and delivery teams to make sure complex consulting and delivery programs succeed, from pre-sales through initial delivery. You’ll make sure the solution is well scoped and truly deliverable, the commitments in the Statement of Work are clear, dependencies and risks are managed early, and the program launches with a strong start and stays on track.

This role is built for leaders who thrive on complexity, enjoy bringing teams and technologies together, and want to be accountable for getting large modernization programs off to a successful start.

  

**What you will do**

**Coordinate from pre-sales to initial delivery**

* Lead coordination across sales, architects, consulting, legal, and delivery teams so that complex modernization programs are well shaped from pre-sales through launch and initial delivery.

* Lead technical solution management, including scoping, proof-of-concept (PoC) framing, assumptions, dependencies, baselining, and delivery readiness.

* Own or contribute to SoW creation and review, with clear deliverables, acceptance criteria, and execution model, so that what is sold is what can be delivered.

* Guide the transition from pre-sales to delivery, and stay engaged through initial delivery to confirm early milestones are met and the program is on track.

**Orchestrate complex, multi-tower programs**

* Coordinate cross-tower teams, delivery plans, dependencies, risks, and mitigation actions across the modernization landscape.

* Stitch together a single, optimized modernization solution that spans domains such as application modernization, cloud migration and modernization, mainframe modernization, and network & edge modernization.

* Drive modernization execution across subdomains such as application management services (AMS), SDLC transformation, AppMod, Mainframe Mod, Platform Engineering, Data Center Networks, and Edge Networks.

**Tell the story and bring the tools**

* Build and deliver client-facing presentations with strong content, narrative framing, and a clear value proposition.

Apply agentic AI capabilities and proven modernization playbooks to strengthen execution and outcomes.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* Proven 8+ years experience coordinating or leading complex, large-scale modernization programs, from pre-sales and solutioning through delivery.

* Broad modernization expertise across applications, cloud, mainframe, and network & edge, and the ability to unify multiple solution components into a single client solution.

* Ability to consolidate and integrate technical solutions across towers into a cohesive modernization program.

* Strong hands-on technical solution leadership, including scoping and PoC framing; assumptions, dependencies, and baselining; and SoW creation and review.

* Strong client communication and presentation skills, including content creation, narrative framing, storytelling, and value proposition articulation.

Experience applying AI-enabled tools and repeatable modernization frameworks to shape or run modernization execution.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience with large, strategic deals and their delivery, including complex stakeholder management and governance.

* Experience running modernization in hybrid estates that involve multiple platforms and cross-tower execution (for example, mainframe, distributed, cloud, and network/security).

A track record of driving risk management, dependency orchestration, and delivery predictability at scale.  



**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Hostess
description:
Department: Food & Beverage (F&B)  
Industry: Fine Dining Restaurant

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a well-groomed, confident, and guest-oriented Hostess to create a warm and memorable first impression for guests visiting our fine dining restaurant. The Hostess will be responsible for welcoming guests, managing reservations, coordinating seating arrangements, handling guest enquiries, and ensuring a smooth and personalised dining experience while maintaining the restaurant's hospitality standards.

2. Roles & Responsibilities

* Welcome guests warmly with a professional and pleasant attitude.
* Create an excellent first impression through proper grooming and hospitality etiquette.
* Greet guests with a smile and escort them to their designated tables.
* Assist guests with seating preferences and special requests.
* Ensure guests feel comfortable and valued throughout their visit.
* Maintain professional communication and body language.

B. Reservation Management

* Handle restaurant reservations through telephone, email, and online platforms.
* Maintain accurate reservation records and guest details.
* Confirm reservations and follow up with guests when required.
* Manage walk-in guests and waiting lists efficiently.
* Coordinate table allocation according to reservation schedules.

C. Table Management & Coordination

* Coordinate with the Restaurant Manager and Service Team regarding table availability.
* Ensure smooth seating arrangements and efficient table rotation.
* Monitor table status and communicate waiting times accurately.
* Coordinate with the service team to ensure tables are ready before seating guests.
* Avoid overcrowding and maintain a comfortable dining environment.

E. Communication & Coordination

* Maintain effective communication with the Restaurant Manager, Captain, and service team.
* Inform the service team about guest arrivals and seating requirements.
* Coordinate with the kitchen regarding special guest requests when required.
* Communicate delays, table availability, and guest concerns professionally.
* Ensure smooth coordination between the reception and restaurant operations.

F. Guest Complaint Handling

* Listen carefully to guest concerns and feedback.
* Handle minor guest complaints politely and professionally.
* Inform the Restaurant Manager about serious complaints or service issues.
* Follow up with guests to ensure their concerns are addressed.
* Maintain a positive attitude even during busy service hours.

G. Restaurant Ambience & Presentation

* Ensure the reception area is clean, organised, and welcoming.
* Maintain proper grooming and uniform standards.
* Ensure menus and reservation registers are properly maintained.
* Maintain awareness of restaurant ambience and guest comfort.
* Ensure the entrance and waiting area reflect the restaurant's luxury positioning.

3. Qualifications & Experience

* Diploma or degree in Hotel Management / Hospitality preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience as a Hostess in a fine dining restaurant or luxury hotel.
* Previous experience in premium hospitality establishments is an advantage.
* Good knowledge of restaurant reservation systems and POS systems.
* Excellent English communication skills.
* Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal and interpersonal communication.
* Pleasant personality and professional appearance.
* Strong guest-handling and relationship management skills.
* Good reservation and table management abilities.
* Confidence in handling VIP guests.
* Multitasking and time management skills.
* Problem-solving and complaint-handling abilities.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to remain calm and professional during busy service periods.
* Strong teamwork and coordination skills.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Guest satisfaction and welcome experience.
* Reservation accuracy and management.
* Efficient table allocation and seating.
* Guest waiting time management.
* VIP and regular guest recognition.
* Professional grooming and personal presentation.
* Guest feedback and complaint resolution.
* Coordination with the restaurant service team.

6. Reporting Structure

* Reports To: Restaurant Manager / Assistant Restaurant Manager
* Coordinates With: Captain, Restaurant Supervisor and Service Team.
* Department: Food & Beverage
* Position: Hostess

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹23,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Endpoint Management Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Be an essential element to a brighter future.

We work together to transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health. Join our values-led organization committed to building a more resilient world with people and planet in mind. Our core values are the foundation that make us successful for ourselves, our customers and the planet.

**Job Description**

Albemarle is hiring for a Senior Endpoint Management Engineer. This position is located in India and hybrid.

  
  

What You Will Do

* Administer and enhance Microsoft's endpoint management ecosystem, including Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID device management, and mobile device management (MDM) capabilities.
* Design, implement, and maintain endpoint configuration, compliance, security baselines, and device lifecycle standards.
* Manage endpoint provisioning, enrollment, software deployment, patching, and operating system upgrade initiatives.
* Support endpoint security controls in partnership with cybersecurity teams, including Microsoft Defender, Conditional Access, device compliance, and Zero Trust initiatives.
* Develop automation and self-service capabilities to improve endpoint management efficiency and user experience.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex endpoint, enrollment, application deployment, and device compliance issues.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, standards, dashboards, and reporting related to endpoint management services.
  

  

What You Bring

Required:

* 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise endpoint management, desktop engineering, systems administration, or workplace technology services.
* Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.
* Experience with Windows endpoint configuration, application packaging and deployment, software distribution, and patch management.
* Knowledge of device compliance, endpoint security controls, Conditional Access, and endpoint lifecycle management.
* Experience troubleshooting endpoint operating systems, device enrollment, application deployment, and user support issues in a global environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  

  

Preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience supporting large-scale enterprise endpoint environments.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), PowerShell automation, and endpoint security platforms.
* Experience integrating endpoint management solutions with Microsoft 365 and cloud identity services.
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent.
* Strong customer-service orientation and ability to partner effectively with global IT and business teams.
* Experience supporting multinational organizations with standardized endpoint management practices.

**Benefits of Joining Albemarle**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package
* A diverse array of resources to support you professionally and personally.

We are partners to one another in pioneering new ways to be better for ourselves, our teams, and our communities. When you join Albemarle, you become our most essential element and you can anticipate competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and resources that foster your well-being and fuel your personal growth. Help us shape the future, build with purpose and grow together.

title: Senior IBM Z Disaster Recovery Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Senior IBM Z Disaster Recovery Specialist, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining disaster recovery and business continuity solutions for IBM Z (Mainframe) environments. You will ensure the resilience, availability, and recoverability of critical business systems while supporting enterprise-wide recovery objectives and compliance requirements.

**What You Will DO**

  

* Provide technical leadership and hands-on support for IBM Z disaster recovery exercises, failover testing, and recovery events.
* Execute and validate recovery procedures to ensure critical systems, applications, and services meet defined RTO and RPO targets.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, storage, database, middleware, network, and security teams to coordinate successful recovery operations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues identified during DR testing, recovery execution, and resilience assessments.
* Maintain and enhance disaster recovery documentation, runbooks, recovery procedures, and operational standards.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing recovery outcomes, mitigating risks, and strengthening enterprise resiliency and business continuity capabilities.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 7+ years of experience in IBM Z (Mainframe) platform administration, operations, infrastructure support, and advanced technical troubleshooting within large-scale enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience supporting and executing Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity activities in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of IBM Z infrastructure components, including z/OS, storage, networking, database, middleware, and security technologies.
* Experience performing recovery validation, recovery testing, and analysis of DR exercise outcomes.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, production support, incident management, and service restoration processes.
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and coordinate recovery activities across multiple technology domains.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with IBM GDPS, Parallel Sysplex, replication technologies, and DR orchestration tools.
* Knowledge of enterprise resiliency, high-availability, and business continuity frameworks.
* Familiarity with Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) management.
* Experience participating in large-scale recovery exercises, failover testing, and audit/compliance activities.
Relevant IBM Mainframe, Infrastructure, Disaster Recovery, or Business Continuity certifications.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Principal - EUC / MDM Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Be the definitive technical authority for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries experience and interact with their devices. This role owns the architecture, reference designs, technical standards and engineering direction for the entire end user computing estate — laptops, desktops, mobiles, tablets, virtual desktops, meeting rooms, and specialised or regulated endpoints.

Where the Director owns delivery, budget and people, the Principal Architect owns what good looks like technically and holds the organisation to it. This is a hands-on-capable role: the expectation is to prototype, prove and pressure-test designs personally, not solely to review other people's slides.

The Principal Architect is accountable for ensuring the estate is secure by design, cloud-native, automatable, cost-efficient and — critically — genuinely pleasant to use. They are the person who says no to architecture that will not survive contact with 50,000 users, and who can explain why in terms both engineers and executives accept.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the target-state architecture for end user computing: platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery, security control placement and telemetry.
* Produce and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, technical standards and architecture decision records (ADRs) — with trade-offs made explicit rather than buried.
* Define the technical roadmap that underpins the EUC strategy: platform migrations, deprecations, convergence of fragmented tooling, and the sequencing that makes it deliverable.
* Continuously evaluate the market — modern management, AI PCs and on-device inference, cloud PC/DaaS economics, zero-trust endpoint models — and separate genuine capability from vendor narrative.
* Act as the design authority for all endpoint change: chair or sit on the EUC architecture review board, approve significant designs, and hold veto on standards deviation.
* Set and police the exception process — make the right path the easy path, and make deviations visible, time-bound and owned.
* Review and assure supplier and MSP technical designs; ensure partners build to the organisation's architecture rather than their own delivery convenience.
* Set engineering standards for configuration-as-code, packaging, testing, release management and rollback across the endpoint estate.
* Prototype and prove new capability in a lab before it reaches production; build the reference implementation the engineering teams then industrialise.
* Mentor and technically develop senior engineers and platform leads; raise the ceiling of the whole team, not just your own output.
* Partner with Cyber Security to embed zero-trust principles at the endpoint: device trust and attestation, conditional access, least privilege, application control, EDR and DLP placement.
* Architect for regulated and validated environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), data residency and privacy obligations, and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation as a designed-in property rather than a manual scramble.
* Own the technical response to endpoint-relevant threat scenarios and drive architectural remediation of systemic vulnerabilities.
* Architect the digital employee experience (DEX) telemetry model: what is measured, how it is collected, where it lands, and how it drives automated remediation.
* Design for self-healing and self-service by default; treat every recurring ticket category as an architectural defect until proven otherwise.
* Translate architecture into business consequence for senior stakeholders — cost, risk, productivity, time-to-value.
* Represent EUC architecture in enterprise architecture forums, security governance, and vendor executive briefings.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional expertise.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Jamf Certified Expert, TOGAF, CISSP or SABSA).

**Area of Specialisation**

* End user computing architecture at global enterprise scale — platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery and telemetry.
* Modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management (Jamf), including co-management, hybrid-to-cloud-native migration and staged ring-based rollout.
* Endpoint security architecture and zero-trust design — device trust, conditional access, application control, EDR/XDR, DLP and secure baselines.
* Regulated and validated endpoint environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, CSV/CSA, data residency and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation designed in.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and 12+ years in IT infrastructure or end user computing, including 5+ years in a principal, lead or enterprise architect capacity with recognised design authority.
* Architecture ownership for an endpoint estate of 20,000+ devices across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.
* Expert-level, hands-on-derived command of modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management — sufficient to build the reference implementation personally, not only to specify it.
* Demonstrable advanced scripting and automation portfolio; evidence of configuration-as-code applied to a production endpoint estate.
* Working fluency in enterprise endpoint security and zero-trust architecture, with a track record of co-designing controls alongside a Cyber Security function.
* Led the architecture of at least one large-scale endpoint platform migration or transformation through to production, including the failures and what was learned from them.
* Able to produce architecture documentation of a standard that withstands external audit and supplier scrutiny.
* Proven credibility with both senior engineers and executive stakeholders, in English, in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [5–15]% of the time.

Desirable:

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — with practical GxP/CSV/CSA and Annex 11 / 21 CFR Part 11 exposure.
* Architecture for specialised endpoints: laboratory instrument workstations, manufacturing and shop-floor devices, clinical and field devices, kiosks, shared and multi-user workstations.
Leading a major platform transformation: SCCM-to-Intune migration, Windows 10* 11 at scale, MSP transition, or M&A integration/divestment of an endpoint estate.
* Sustainability-aware design — device longevity, power management, refurbishment and Scope 3 implications of architectural choices.
* Accessibility and assistive technology designed into the standard build rather than bolted on.
* Network fundamentals relevant to endpoints — SASE/ZTNA, split tunnelling, Wi-Fi 6/7, certificate-based network access.
* Contribution to the wider community — open-source tooling, conference speaking, published technical writing, vendor customer advisory boards.

**Skills/Background**

* Deep technical breadth across Windows and macOS internals, modern endpoint management, identity, endpoint security, application delivery, virtual desktop / cloud PC, and mobile — with the judgement to know where tenant-wide standardisation matters and where a business exception is defensible.
* Advanced PowerShell and at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Go) applied to real automation, not toy scripts.
* Configuration-as-code and GitOps discipline — version-controlled endpoint configuration, CI/CD for policy and package deployment, automated testing and staged ring-based rollout as the default way endpoint change is delivered.
* API-first integration — Microsoft Graph, ServiceNow, MDM and security tool APIs; designing integrations that survive vendor change.
* Telemetry and data craft — designing measurement into the estate, with competence in the query languages and platforms the data lands in (KQL, Log Analytics, Power BI or equivalent).
* Architectural discipline — reference designs, ADRs, HLD/LLD, and the ability to write clearly enough that others can build from it and external auditors can accept it.
* Trade-off reasoning — cost, risk, experience, security and operability weighed explicitly; comfortable being the person who quantifies the uncomfortable option.
* Scale intuition — designing for 50,000 devices, unreliable networks, disconnected users, and the long tail of exceptions that always exists.
* Technical leadership without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery and vendors by credibility and evidence.
* Executive communication — making architecture legible and decision-ready for non-technical leadership.
* Constructive challenge — able to disagree with a Director, a vendor or a security architect and keep the relationship intact.

**Skills**

Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Design Thinking, Endpoint Encryption, Endpoint Security, End User Services, Financial Operations, Jamf Pro, Network Protocols, Network Security, Zero Trust

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Manager IAM Architecture
description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed.

The IAM Security Assurance Architect is responsible for reviewing all new applications, platforms, cloud services, and technology changes to ensure they meet the organisation's baseline IAM security requirements before they go live.

The role acts as the IAM security review authority within technology delivery and change processes, and builds the automation needed to provide continuous assurance that identity and access controls remain effective throughout the application lifecycle. The focus is on two outcomes: rigorous security reviews and automated, always-on assurance.

Key Responsibilities

1. IAM Security Reviews

* Serve as the IAM security review authority for new applications, technology platforms, cloud workloads, and infrastructure changes.
* Review designs and change requests through project lifecycle and design checkpoint governance processes.
* Assess and approve applications against baseline IAM security requirements, including:
  + Authentication standards
  + MFA requirements
  + Privileged access controls
  + Role-based access models
  + Segregation of Duties requirements
  + Identity lifecycle (joiner / mover / leaver) requirements
  + Account provisioning and deprovisioning controls
  + Service account and non-human identity management standards
  + Federation and Single Sign-On requirements
* Review application access models, role structures, entitlement designs, and access matrices.
* Classify application criticality and confirm IAM onboarding requirements are met.
* Identify security risks, control gaps, and remediation actions, and confirm closure before deployment.
* Provide clear, documented review decisions and risk-based approvals to delivery teams.

2. Assurance Automation & Continuous Compliance

* Design and build automation that continuously validates whether applications and platforms meet baseline IAM security requirements.
* Automate evidence collection and control checks to reduce manual review effort and provide always-on assurance.
* Establish automated, continuous monitoring for:
  + Orphaned accounts
  + Stale and dormant identities
  + Excessive or unused privileges
  + Toxic access combinations
  + Service account and non-human identity risks
  + Privileged account misuse
  + Deviations from approved access baselines
* Integrate assurance checks with IAM platforms and security tooling (e.g., SailPoint, Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, cloud CIEM).
* Define Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and IAM assurance health metrics.
* Build and maintain dashboards that surface control effectiveness and non-compliance for remediation.
* Drive an automate-first approach to control validation, minimising point-in-time manual checks.

3. Remediation, Risk & Reporting

* Track and drive closure of IAM security review findings and assurance exceptions.
* Review IAM-related risk assessments, exceptions, and remediation plans.
* Support internal and external audits with review evidence and assurance data.
* Report on review throughput, control coverage, and residual risk to IAM leadership.

4. Stakeholder Engagement

* Partner with application, engineering, cloud, and change teams to embed security-by-design in delivery.
* Advise project teams on how to meet baseline IAM requirements early in the lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Security, Risk, and Audit functions on assurance outcomes and control gaps.

Key Deliverables

* IAM Security Review Decisions & Risk-Based Approvals
* Baseline IAM Requirement Assessments for New Applications
* Continuous Assurance Automation & Control Validation Framework
* Automated Evidence Collection & Compliance Checks
* IAM Assurance Dashboards & Metrics (KRIs / KPIs)
* Review Findings, Remediation Tracking & Exception Reviews
* Assurance Reporting for IAM Leadership and Audit

Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

* Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) – SailPoint ISC / IdentityIQ
* Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory
* CyberArk Privileged Access Management
* Authentication & Federation Protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML)
* Cloud Identity Security and CIEM (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Service Account and Non-Human Identity Management
* IAM Automation, Scripting and Orchestration (e.g., Power Automate, Python, APIs)
* Security Analytics, Monitoring and Continuous Assurance Tooling
* Baseline IAM Security Requirements and Control Testing

Review & Assurance Capability

* Security design review and change assessment processes
* Secure-by-design and baseline requirement validation
* Automated control testing and evidence collection
* Technology risk assessment and remediation tracking
* Metrics, KRI/KPI definition and assurance reporting
* Audit support and control effectiveness validation

Professional Experience

* Experience performing IAM or security design reviews for applications and platforms.
* Experience assessing applications against baseline IAM / access control requirements.
* Experience building automation for control validation, evidence collection, or continuous assurance.
* Experience integrating assurance checks with IAM and security tooling.
* Experience tracking and driving remediation of identity and access control gaps.
* Experience engaging with delivery, engineering, risk, and audit stakeholders.

Qualifications & Certifications

Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of overall experience in information security or IT, with 5+ years focused on Identity & Access Management.
* 3+ years performing IAM / security design reviews or control assurance for applications and platforms.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience building automation for control validation, evidence collection, or continuous assurance.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following certifications is preferred:

* CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional
* CISM – Certified Information Security Manager
* CIAM / Identity certifications (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft Entra / Identity & Access Administrator SC-300)
* CyberArk Defender / Sentry (Privileged Access Management)
* Cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft SC-100 / AZ-500, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer)
* CCSP – Certified Cloud Security Professional
CISA – Certified Information Systems Auditor (for controls assurance and audit alignment)

We encourage the same standards from our recruitment and third-party suppliers taking into account the context of grade, job and location. We also allow for reasonable adjustments to support people with individual physical or mental health requirements.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.
  
  
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Perform SAP BASIS administration activities across SAP landscapes (ECC, BW, Solution Manager, S/4HANA, Java systems).
* Monitor and maintain SAP systems to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
* Execute SAP kernel upgrades, support package implementations, and system refreshes/copies.
* Manage SAP transport activities and troubleshoot transport-related issues.
* Perform client administration, user administration, and security-related BASIS tasks.
* Monitor SAP background jobs, system logs, spool management, and interface connectivity.
* Support HANA database administration activities, including backups and recovery.
* Execute OS and database-level troubleshooting in collaboration with infrastructure teams.
* Participate in incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Support cloud-based SAP environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, SAP RISE) as required.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and operational reports.
Provide on-call support and participate in planned maintenance activities.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills**

  

* 3-5 years of SAP BASIS administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, and SAP HANA.
* Experience with system monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of SAP transport management and change management processes.
* Experience in system copy, client copy, refresh, upgrades, and patching activities.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix and Windows server administration.
* Understanding of backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability concepts.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or SAP RISE environments.
Good understanding of ITIL processes and ticketing tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* SAP BASIS or SAP HANA certification(not mandator. Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are a plus.
* Experience in SAP RISE operations.
Strong communication, customer handling, and documentation skills.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: clinic counsellor
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, confident and target-driven **Sales Counsellor** to join our skin and aesthetic clinic.

This is a revenue-focused role. The counsellor will be responsible for converting enquiries and leads into consultations and treatments, counselling clients on suitable treatment plans, following up consistently, and ensuring that the clinic meets its daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets.

The ideal candidate should be an excellent communicator, comfortable discussing premium aesthetic treatments, persistent with follow-ups, highly organised and able to take ownership of numbers rather than wait for clients to walk in.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Revenue**

* Take ownership of the clinic's **daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets**.
* Follow up aggressively and consistently on new leads, enquiries, past consultations and existing clients.
* Convert incoming leads from calls, WhatsApp, digital campaigns, social media and other sources into clinic appointments.
* Counsel clients on relevant skin, hair, laser and aesthetic treatments based on their concerns and the doctor's recommendations.
* Explain treatment plans, packages, pricing, offers and payment options clearly and confidently.
* Identify opportunities for **cross-selling, upselling and treatment upgrades** without compromising the client's experience or clinical appropriateness.
* Follow up with clients who have consulted but not yet purchased or started treatment.
* Reactivate dormant clients and encourage repeat treatments, maintenance plans and package renewals.
* Track upcoming package expiries, incomplete treatment plans and potential repeat business.

**Lead Management & Follow-up**

* Respond promptly to all incoming leads and enquiries.
* Maintain a disciplined follow-up system so that no potential client is lost because of delayed or missed communication.
* Understand the client's concern, establish intent and guide them towards booking a consultation or treatment.
* Maintain detailed notes on every lead, including treatment interest, objections, follow-up dates and conversion status.
* Handle common objections around pricing, treatment concerns, downtime and decision-making confidently and professionally.

**Client Counselling**

* Build rapport quickly and make clients feel comfortable discussing aesthetic concerns.
* Explain treatments in simple, easy-to-understand language.
* Work closely with doctors, nurses and therapists to recommend the right treatment journey for each client.
* Ensure that counselling is persuasive and commercially effective while remaining ethical and aligned with medical recommendations.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to improve retention, referrals and repeat business.

**Reporting & Organisation**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, consultations, conversions and revenue.
* Prepare and update **daily, weekly and monthly sales reports**.
* Review the sales pipeline daily and prioritise high-potential leads.
* Maintain client information and follow-up schedules accurately in the clinic CRM/software or designated trackers.
* Provide regular updates to the Management on performance against targets.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be measured on:

* Monthly clinic revenue achievement
* Individual revenue contribution
* Lead-to-appointment conversion
* Consultation-to-sale conversion
* Follow-up effectiveness
* Repeat and renewal business
* Cross-sell and upsell revenue
* Reactivation of existing/dormant clients
* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting
* Client experience and feedback

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly sales-driven and target-oriented**
* Extremely proactive and persistent with follow-ups
* Confident speaking to clients over phone, WhatsApp and in person
* An excellent communicator with strong persuasion and negotiation skills
* Comfortable asking for the sale and closing conversations
* Well organised and disciplined about maintaining follow-up records
* Comfortable working with daily, weekly and monthly targets
* Able to analyse their own pipeline and identify what needs to be done to achieve the target
* Presentable, professional and client-focused
* Able to work independently and take ownership rather than wait for instructions
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced clinic environment

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum **2–3 years of experience in sales, counselling or client conversion**.
* Previous experience in an **aesthetic clinic, dermatology clinic, cosmetic surgery centre, wellness clinic, premium salon or healthcare sales environment** is strongly preferred.
* Experience selling premium treatments, packages or high-value services will be an advantage.
* Strong spoken English is essential. Knowledge of Hindi and/or Kannada is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp and CRM or clinic management software is required.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Optometrist

title: Associate Director - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 8-10 years in cloud and SAP infrastructure, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems.
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

  

* Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Development, Reliability Engineering, SAP Infrastructure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

description:

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe Systems Operations Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. Monitor and manage IBM z/OS production environments by performing console monitoring, system health checks, IPL support, and daily operational activities, while troubleshooting batch processing issues related to JCL, scheduling, datasets, and job execution to ensure high availability, stability, and operational excellence.

* Monitor, control, and troubleshoot batch workloads, ensuring successful completion of production processing within established SLAs.

* Support enterprise workload automation tools such as CA-7, Control-M, and IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS), managing job dependencies and critical production workflows.
Investigate and resolve production incidents, participate in major incident management activities, and perform root cause analysis following ITIL best practices.  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* Monitor production systems, devices, and infrastructure components, proactively identifying and resolving operational issues.

.

* Proactively identify operational improvement opportunities and coordinate with appropriate support teams.
* Assess issue severity, perform timely escalations, and drive incident resolution.
* Communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders across all organizational levels.
Work independently in a production support environment while maintaining operational excellence.

title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Network Capabilities
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering shared network services such as Domain Name System, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and Internet Protocol address management.
* Strong knowledge of network access control, application programming interfaces, automation, monitoring and resilient service design.
* Evidence of improving service reliability, self service, deployment speed or operational efficiency.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

AI Programming, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Data Distribution Service (DDS), Data Management and Integration (DMI), IP Address Management (IPAM), Leadership, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Security Management, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Universal Description Discovery and Integration (UDDI), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. description:

==================================================

* 15+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure design, implementation, and management.
* Expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture and administration.

* Proficiency in Google Cloud CLI, Shell Scripting, Python, and Ansible.
* Experience in large-scale cloud operations, migration, modernization, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Strong knowledge of: Cloud Security & IA Governance & Organizational Policies Encryption & Secrets Management Network Security Cost Optimization
* Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, performance and capacity management.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, incident management, and root cause analysis.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions.
* Understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.

**Preferred Professional Experience:**
======================================

* Experience with **G** oogle Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Exposure to Google Cloud managed database services.
* Expertise in Cloud Interconnect and enterprise-scale GCE environments.
* Experience integrating GCP with on-premises infrastructure.
* Experience creating architecture documentation, operational standards, and runbooks.
* Focus on automation and continuous service improvement.

title: Associate Director - IAM Advanced Authentication
description:
