Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**:

Every person, workload and AI agent at GSK needs an identity it can prove, credentials that cannot be stolen and access that is just enough, just in time. As our applications move to the cloud and AI agents begin working alongside our people, authentication is becoming the foundation of trust for everything we do. The Associate Director, leads the engineering and delivery of that foundation, starting with single sign-on (SSO) and extending the same discipline to Azure and Google Cloud (GCP), non-human identities (NHI) and AI agents.

**Our vision:**

  

One trusted way to authenticate, whoever or whatever is asking for access: passwordless for people, secretless for workloads and tightly scoped for AI agents. Security should be invisible when everything is right and decisive when it is not. We will get there by using AI securely in our own work, setting the example for the rest of GSK.

**About the team:**

  

Authentication and Cloud Security is part of Identity & Access Management. We build and run SSO for GSK’s workforce and applications, and bring the same discipline to securing the accounts, credentials and authentication of cloud, non-human and AI agent identities. Together with PKI & Cryptographic Services, we protect the identities, secrets and keys that GSK’s cloud and AI future depends on.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will turn that vision into reality. Your responsibilities will include:

* **Build one team:** Lead and develop a global team of engineers across SSO, cloud, NHI and AI agent identity, working as one team with shared patterns rather than separate product silos.
* **Deliver the roadmap:** Own the engineering roadmap, delivery plans and service measures, turning the agreed architecture and standards into reliable services.
* **Make sign-in passwordless and trusted:** Run GSK’s SSO services (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), moving the workforce to passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication, with conditional access, strong identity verification for registration and account recovery, and the retirement of legacy authentication.
* **Secure the cloud:** Protect cloud accounts and access in Azure and GCP with strong authentication, workload identity federation, least privilege and just-in-time access, with no standing admin rights.
* **Bring workloads and AI agents into the fold:** Give non-human identities and AI agents unique, accountable identities kept separate from human ones, with protected credentials, scoped and revocable access and full audit logging, and promote integration with GSK’s identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* **Move from secrets to secretless:** Drive adoption of secrets vaulting and management, remove hard-coded credentials, favour short-lived and secretless authentication, and build secret scanning into engineering pipelines.
* **Partner with PKI:** Work with the PKI & Cryptographic Services lead to secure cloud, AI and secrets, with aligned roadmaps, clear ownership and a joined-up approach for stakeholders and auditors.
* **Use AI ourselves:** Apply AI to identity engineering and operations, such as risky sign-in analysis, anomaly detection, faster onboarding and incident triage, with human oversight and clear audit trails.
* **Set the example:** Show GSK what secure cloud and AI looks like through secure-by-default implementations, reusable patterns, automation and implementation guidelines.
* **Keep trust earned:** Ensure these services meet audit and compliance requirements, including GxP, SOX, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and lead major incidents and continual improvement with partner teams.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in computer science, information technology, cyber security or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least 18 years’ experience in identity or security, including leading engineering teams that deliver and run enterprise identity or security services in a large organisation.
* Strong knowledge of SSO and modern authentication (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), conditional access, multi-factor authentication and passwordless authentication.
* Hands-on experience securing identity and access in Azure, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure role-based access control and workload identities.
* Experience securing non-human identities and secrets, including vaulting, credential rotation and removing embedded secrets, and integrating them with identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and large language model security risks, such as agent permissions, data exposure and prompt injection.
* Strong leadership, delivery and communication skills, including managing roadmaps, suppliers and audits, and explaining technical risk to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience delivering SSO at scale with Microsoft Entra ID or Ping Identity, including passwordless authentication and identity verification.
* Experience securing identity and access in Google Cloud (GCP), and with tools for securing non-human identity credentials and cloud privileged access.
* Experience with secrets vaulting and management platforms such as Akeyless, CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault or Google Secret Manager.
* Experience securing AI agents or platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI or Copilot, and familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Working understanding of PKI and certificate-based authentication, and experience with Terraform and identity automation.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator, Azure Security Engineer or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
* Experience in pharmaceuticals or another highly regulated industry.

Typical tools and technologies: Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, passkeys and FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, Azure, Google Cloud, Akeyless, CyberArk, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Graph, Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Authentication, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Cloud IAM, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Directory Services, Engineering Leadership, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secure Authentication, Security Controls, Server Security, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. **About the Role**
------------------

  
  

As a **Technical People Manager for the Slack Practice** within Salesforce Professional Services (GDC), you will build, coach, and lead a high-performing team of Slack technical consultants, developers, and architects. In this role, you will bridge the gap between people leadership, technical architecture, and enterprise delivery excellence.
  
You will partner closely with global practice leaders, onshore engagement managers, and enterprise customers to deliver complex Slack transformations—ranging from large-scale Enterprise Grid migrations and custom app development to next-generation Agentforce and Salesforce integrations.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Industries Cloud.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of 15 technical consultants, Slack developers, and technical architects.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance appraisals, goal-setting, and career progression planning.
* Drive team enablement initiatives, certification bootcamp ( Certified Slack Developer, Certified Slack Admin ), and hands-on skill development across emerging features ( Agentforce in Slack, Slack CLI).
* Lead recruitment, technical interviews, and onboarding to scale the Slack practice with top-tier talent.
* Cultivate an inclusive, collaborative, and innovation-driven culture within the GDC.
* Serve as a **Technical Architect** for Slack enterprise implementations, providing architectural oversight across client deliverables.
* Establish best practices, reusable code repositories, standard operating frameworks, and review gates for Slack custom apps (Bolt framework, Block Kit, API limits, and security).
* Oversee enterprise migration architectures, ensuring best practices for identity mapping, data retention, DLP compliance, and cutover execution.
* Champion architecture reviews and guide technical teams through complex customer design challenges.
* Partner with Resource Management and Global Practice Directors to ensure optimal staffing, utilization, and project readiness.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Collaborate with onshore delivery teams to scope technical effort, review estimates, and ensure seamless global delivery collaboration.
* Lead practice initiatives around **Slack + Salesforce** convergence (e.g., Agentforce for Slack, Salesforce Channels, CRM integrations).
* Drive internal IP development, such as reusable Slack accelerators, migration automation scripts, and workflow templates.
  

  
  

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies:**
---------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Slack Enterprise Grid & Administration:**
  + Deep understanding of Slack Enterprise Grid topology, multi-workspace scoping, and enterprise governance.
  + Experience with identity lifecycle management: SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and SCIM directory sync.
  + Strong foundation in enterprise security, compliance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), eDiscovery, Enterprise Key Management (EKM), and the Slack Audit Logs API.
  + Governance of Slack Connect, external collaboration policies, and app installation approval pipelines.
* **Slack App Development & APIs:**
  + Proven hands-on background in Slack app development using the **Bolt Framework** (Node.js or Python).
  + Mastery of **Block Kit** , interactive UI components, modals, and App Home tab architectures.
  + Thorough knowledge of the Slack Web API, Events API, Webhooks, Socket Mode vs. HTTP endpoint configurations, and rate-limiting best practices.
  + Familiarity with the Slack CLI, modular app architecture, manifest files (manifest.json), and Workflow Builder custom functions.
* **Enterprise Migration & Consolidation:**
  + Architectural knowledge of migrating from legacy communication platforms (Microsoft Teams, Mattermost, freemium/standalone Slack workspaces) to Slack Enterprise Grid.
  + Familiarity with user/channel mapping schemas, export/import APIs, data parity verification, and cutover runbook execution.
* **DevOps & Engineering Standards:**
  + Solid understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, automated testing frameworks, and secure API integration standards.
  + Experience hosting Slack apps on cloud infrastructure (Heroku, AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**
-----------------------------------------

  
  

* **Total Experience:** 10-15+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, or enterprise cloud solutions.
* **Management Experience:** 5+ years of direct people management experience leading technical teams (software engineers, technical consultants, or architects) in a global delivery / consulting model.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):**
--------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Salesforce Platform Knowledge:**
  + Familiarity with core Salesforce platform capabilities (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Platform Events, Apex, Flow).
  + Hands-on experience or architectural knowledge of integrating Salesforce with Slack (Salesforce for Slack apps, CRM record sync, Agentforce integration).
* **Certifications:**
  + **Certified Slack Administrator** or **Certified Slack Developer** (highly preferred).
  + Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I).
* Experience working in large-scale professional services, system integration (SI) consultancies, or enterprise SaaS vendor delivery centers.

Unleash Your Potential

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. Facility Engineer with below requirement.
  
  
A. Power Quality, Distribution & ReliabilityOperate and maintain LT systems, transformers, LT panels, PDU/RPP, isolation transformers, and static transfer switches (STS).
  
Ensure N+1 / 2N redundancy for critical loads (process tools, scrubbers, abatement, BMS, safety systems).
  
Monitor harmonics (THD), transients, flicker, and EMI/RFI; implement filters/SPDs and isolation strategies for sensitive tools (litho, metrology).
  
Perform load studies, phase balancing, and feeder capacity checks prior to tool hookups and expansions.
  
B. UPS, Emergency Power & ControlsOperate and maintain UPS (modular/N+1), battery strings, DG sets, AMF/ATS panels; test black start and autotransfer sequences.
  
Periodic battery health tests (IR, discharge tests), UPS efficiency tuning, and firmware/config backup.
  
Maintain Emergency Power Off (EPO) circuits, interlocks with gas monitoring systems, and fire alarm interfaces.
  
C. Grounding, Bonding & ESDMaintain clean/technical grounds, separate from building ground; verify low-impedance paths and equipotential bonding for tools.
  
Implement and audit ESD controls (SEMI S20.20 practices), wrist straps, surfaces, flooring resistance, and static-safe layouts in cleanroom and chase areas.
  
D. Maintenance, Monitoring & ResponseEstablish PM/CBM for panels, breakers, relays, STS, UPS, and IR thermography for hot spots.
  
Trend MTBF/MTTR, create SPC charts for voltage, frequency, THD, and temperature rise.
  
Lead RCA on trips/nuisance faults; implement corrective and preventive actions.
  
E. Safety & Compliance (Electrical)Enforce LOTO, arc-flash boundaries, insulated tools, and PPE.
  
Maintain single-line diagrams, relay settings, test reports (IR, ER), and statutory compliance under CEA Regulations, Indian Electrical Safety Rules, and local inspectorate requirements.
  
Integrate BMS/EPMS alarms, define SOPs for emergency shutdowns and controlled restarts.
  
2) Facility Engineer – Mechanical / Process Utilities (Semiconductor Labs)Primary Objective:
  
Ensure stable, spec-compliant utilities for process tools and cleanroom performance with high uptime and contamination control.
  
A. Cleanroom & HVAC (Critical Environment)Operate and optimize MAUs/AHUs/FFUs, HEPA/ULPA filtration, pressurization cascades, temperature & RH controls.
  
Maintain ISO 14644 cleanroom classes; track particle counts, airflow, and room recovery times.
  
Handle filter life-cycle management, leak tests (DOP/PAO), duct hygiene, and IAQ.
  
Seasonal tuning of coils, economizer modes, and dew point management to prevent condensation in bays/chasers.
  
B. Chilled Water / PCW / Operate chillers (centrifugal/screw), CTs, primary/secondary pumping, and PCW loops for tools.
  
Maintain temperature stability, ΔT, flow, and vibration on critical pumps; maintain N+1 for critical circuits.
  
**Water treatment:** scaling/corrosion inhibitors, biocide control, blowdown optimization.
  
**Trending:** SPC on supply temp, differential pressure, specific energy consumption.
  
C. Ultra-Pure Water (UPW/DI) & WastewaterManage rinse loops, sanitization schedules, and return/reclaim strategies (if applicable).
  
D. Compressed Air (CDA), Vacuum & Inert GasesOperate oil-free compressors, dryers, and filtration to meet dew point and oil/particulate specs; maintain VMB/VMP pressures.
  
Maintain central vacuum and dry pump systems for tools; plan overhauls, flushing, and pump swap programs with OEMs
  
Manage bulk/packaged nitrogen (N₂), vacuum-jacketed lines (if LN₂), and purges for tools and abatement.
  
E. Fire, Life Safety & Exhaust/VentilationMaintain process exhaust, toxic exhaust, and general exhaust with redundancy and failure interlocks.
  
Coordinate with fire detection/suppression (VESDA, clean agent where applicable), and ensure SEMI S2/S6/S8/S18 oriented risk controls.
  
  
F. Maintenance, Monitoring & Analytics PPMCreate PM schedules for pumps, compressors, chillers, FFUs, filters, cabinets, scrubbers, UPW, and neutralization systems.
  
Use BMS to alarm, trend, and report; deploy predictive maintenance (vibration, oil analysis, dew point trends).
  
Maintain spares strategy for high-risk items (VFDs, AHU motors, pump seals, pH probes, sensors, HEPA/ULPA, MERV prefilters).
  
H. Safety & Compliance (Mechanical/Utilities)Enforce PTW/LOTO, confined space, hot work, and chemical handling SOPs.
  
Comply with Factory Act, Boiler Regulations (if applicable), Lift Act, local PCB norms for discharge, PESO/SMPV Rules for gas storage, and explosion-proof ratings where needed.
  
Maintain MSDS/SDS, calibration certificates, and interlock validation records.
  
3) Common Responsibilities (Both Electrical & Mechanical)Projects & Tool HookupsReview PFD/P&ID, MEP/shop drawings, and hook-up packages; validate utility points, capacity, and interlocks.
  
Coordinate FAT/SAT, commissioning, and as-built updates; manage change control and redlining.
  
Plan shutdowns with clear MOPs (Method of Procedure) and rollback plans—particularly when tying into live loops.
  
Operations, Documentation & ReportingMaintain O&M logs, trend charts, equipment history, and SOP/EOP libraries.
  
**Generate MIS:** uptime, incidents, energy use, water use, chemical use, and environmental KPIs (e.g., CUE/WUE).
  
Track OEE, MTBF/MTTR, and SPC metrics for critical utilities and cleanroom performance.
  
Vendor/OEM & AMC ManagementManage AMCs for chillers, compressors, scrubbers, UPS, gas detection, and UPW.
  
Validate service reports, calibration certificates, and PM checklists; enforce spares and response SLAs.
  
Conduct RCA with OEMs for chronic faults and implement design/controls improvements.
  
EHS, Training & CultureRun toolbox talks, competency training (LOTO, toxic gas, electrical safety, ESD, cleanroom behavior).
  
Lead HIRA/JSA, safety walks, and near-miss programs; maintain permit-to-work rigor.
  
Interface with QA/EHS/Process teams to align operational windows with experiment schedules and risk profiles.
  
4) Day/Week/Month Checklist SnapshotDaily
  
**Power quality & alarms (EPMS/BMS):** voltages, THD, breaker statuses, UPS load, battery float.
  
**Cleanroom:** pressures, temp/RH, particle counts (critical bays), FFU/AHU alarms.
  
**Utilities:** CDA dew point & oil carryover, PCW temps/flows, vacuum levels, UPW resistivity/TOC, scrubber DP/pH/ORP.
  
**Gas monitoring:** sensor health, bump tests where applicable; verify EPO/gas shutdown panels healthy.
  
Weekly
  
**Visual checks:** hot spots via IR (rotational basis), pump vibrations, belt/tension, filter DP trends.
  
Test generator no-load/loaded (per schedule), UPS self-tests, review alarm logs & interlock events.
  
Sample & trend UPW bacteria, cooling tower chemistry; verify tool hook-up backflow preventers.
  
Monthly
  
**Full PMs as per OEM:** compressor dryers, scrubber spray nozzles, HVAC coils & filters, UPS battery IR.
  
**Calibration rotation:** gas sensors, pressure/flow/temp transmitters, pH/ORP meters.
  
Emergency drill (gas leak/EPO) and RCA review of any incidents; update SOPs/MOPs/EOPs.
  
**5) Useful Standards/Frameworks to Align WithSEMI:** S2 (EH&S for equipment), S6 (exhaust ventilation), S8 (ergonomics), S18 (risk assessment), S20/S20.20 (ESD).
  
ISO 14644 (cleanrooms), ASHRAE (HVAC), NFPA (fire protection, electrical safety), IEC/IEEE (electrical), FM Global guidance.
  
**India statutory:** CEA Regulations, Factory Act, PESO/SMPV Rules, local PCB and Electrical Inspectorate requirements.
  
6) Optional Add‑Ons I Can Prepare for YouJD template for Facility Engineer (Semiconductor Utilities) – ready to publish.
  
**SOP/MOP/EOP pack for:** tool hook-up, toxic gas alarm response, EPO/power restoration, abatement startup, and scrubber failure.
  
PM matrix (Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Annual) with OEM references.
  
Commissioning & handover checklist (FAT/SAT, interlock validation, redlines).
  
  
Educational Qualifications
  

* Diploma in Electrical Engineering
* B.Tech Or BE in Electrical Engineering

Job summary
  
JLL is seeking a Facilities Project Lead to support client by serving as the single point of accountability for vendor contract performance and the planning, procurement, and delivery of small facilities projects. This role ensures vendors deliver the full contracted scope at the agreed quality and cost, and that all projects follow one consistent process from request through closeout. In this role, you will help deliver the simplicity, speed, and consistency that define JLL’s integrated approach to real estate and facilities management. You will work across vendor management, project delivery, budgeting, sourcing, and team leadership while supporting JLL’s purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world and our values of Teamwork, Ethics, and Excellence.

Participate in vendor performance reviews with Sourcing Manager and drive scope gaps, quality issues, and corrective actions to resolution.
  
Input into vendor contract renewals, rebids, and scope revisions, including benchmarking and recommendations on whether to renew, renegotiate, or replace.

Reconcile invoices against work performed and approved scope before payment approval.

Flag cost risks and recommend corrective action early.

title: BMC Control-M Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage, and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on. We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive BMC Control-M Administrator to join our team and play a key role in ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and modernization of enterprise workload automation environments.

  

The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in BMC Control-M administration, workload automation, batch scheduling, and production operations support across distributed platforms. This role requires the ability to independently manage the Control-M ecosystem while driving operational excellence, platform stability, security compliance, and continuous service improvement.

  

**What You Will DO**

  

* Lead the administration, engineering, and lifecycle management of the BMC Control-M platform, including Enterprise Manager, Servers, Agents, Control-M Web, upgrades, patching, security, performance optimization, and high-availability configurations across distributed environments.
* Design, implement, and support complex enterprise batch scheduling and workload automation solutions, managing jobs, workflows, calendars, dependencies, resources, and critical production processing to ensure reliable business operations.
* Monitor platform and batch execution health, troubleshoot infrastructure and scheduling issues, perform failure recovery, and provide advanced L2/L3 support for production incidents while ensuring SLA adherence.
* Drive automation and modernization initiatives using Control-M Automation API, REST APIs, scripting, jobs-as-code, and CI/CD integration, reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency.
Collaborate with application, infrastructure, database, network, security, and business teams to onboard new workloads, resolve scheduling challenges, implement best practices, and support enterprise transformation initiatives.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in enterprise workload automation, with strong expertise in BMC Control-M administration and distributed scheduling.
* Demonstrated experience independently administering Control-M/EM, Control-M/Server, and Control-M/Agents in complex enterprise production environments.
* Proven experience with Control-M installations, upgrades, patching, agent management, connectivity troubleshooting, configuration management, and platform lifecycle support.
* Strong technical knowledge of Control-M job scheduling, calendars, dependencies, resources, workflow monitoring, batch recovery, and production scheduling governance.
* Proficiency in UNIX/Linux and Windows administration, including log analysis, process management, networking fundamentals, filesystem operations, and Shell scripting.
* Experience troubleshooting critical production issues and performing structured root cause analysis across distributed workload automation environments.
Understanding of platform security, role-based authorization, secure communication, backup/recovery, and high-availability concepts.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Practical experience with Control-M Automation API, REST APIs, CLI utilities, Python/Shell scripting, and automation-driven administration.
* Experience executing Control-M version upgrades, infrastructure migrations, agent deployment automation, or modernization projects.

title: Head of Regulatory Information Management
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Head of Regulatory Information Management is accountable for the strategy, governance, operating model and performance of the company's RIM capability, including Regulatory Data Governance. The role sets direction for RIM systems, regulatory data standards, stewardship, quality metrics and continuous improvement across Regulatory Affairs, ensuring trusted regulatory data and effective tools support compliant, scalable business processes. Operational execution, hands-on data maintenance, system administration, document processing, routine system updates and training delivery are performed by designated process owners, business administrators and data stewards under their leadership.  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and lead the RIM strategy, roadmap and target operating model, aligned to Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations, Quality and enterprise data and digital priorities.
* Lead and develop the RIM team, including recruitment, onboarding, capability building, succession planning and performance management, while fostering an inclusive and accountable team culture.
* Establish and chair RIM and Regulatory Data Governance forums to align priorities, make cross-functional decisions, resolve escalations and maintain clear ownership of systems, processes and data.
* Own the Regulatory Data Governance framework, including data ownership and stewardship, data standards, data quality thresholds, KPIs, issue escalation and lifecycle controls for regulatory master data.
* Set strategic business ownership and governance for the RIM ecosystem, including Veeva RIM, Lorenz docuBridge, AMS, xEVMPD/IDMP processes and related integrations, ensuring investment and release priorities support business needs.
* Define the resource and operating model needed for sustainable delivery and resilience, delegating operational execution to designated business administrators, process owners and data stewards.
* Monitor RIM, regulatory data quality and process performance metrics, using insights to drive risk-based improvements, CAPA effectiveness, leadership decisions and prioritisation.
* Sponsor continuous improvement and transformation initiatives that simplify processes, strengthen data integrity, improve automation and enable global work-sharing, acting as steering leader rather than day-to-day project manager.
* Ensure RIM systems, processes and data governance practices meet QMS, GDP, data integrity and regulatory expectations, and represent RIM/Data Governance in Regulatory Operations leadership, cross-functional governance and selected external/industry interactions.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* 8+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations or Regulatory Information Management in a regulated life sciences environment, including leadership of global RIM, regulatory systems or regulatory data capabilities.
* Demonstrated people leadership and strategic operating model experience, including budget and resource planning, performance management, capability development and change leadership in a matrix environment.
* Strong understanding of RIM business applications and regulatory data governance, QMS/GxP/GDP, change control, data integrity, regulatory compliance, IDMP/xEVMPD expectations and global registration/submission lifecycle processes.

**Desirable Skills:**

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and align cross-functional teams around shared standards, governance decisions and strategic priorities.
* Experience establishing regulatory data governance, stewardship models, data quality KPIs, issue management and lifecycle controls for regulatory master data.
* Experience shaping digital and data roadmaps, vendor governance and IT-enabled transformation across Veeva Vault/RIM and related regulatory systems.
* Strong analytical, communication and change management capability, with ability to convert metrics, risks and data quality signals into strategy and effective decisions.

The NetSuite Business Systems Analyst – Order to Cash (O2C) is a techno-functional role focused on the configuration, development, support, and optimization of Flexera’s NetSuite Order-to-Cash processes. This position serves as a key resource for designing and implementing system solutions across NetSuite, with responsibility for workflows, integrations, reporting, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform improvements.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical understanding of NetSuite and knows how to translate business needs into effective system configurations and enhancements. This is not an accounting role. It is a business systems position for someone who can work hands-on in NetSuite to improve automation, scalability, data quality, and operational effectiveness across the O2C cycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

NetSuite O2C & Optimization

Configure, enhance, and support NetSuite functionality across the Order-to-Cash process, including customer setup, order management, billing, collections, and revenue-related workflows.

Design, build, and maintain NetSuite configurations such as custom fields, forms, records, roles, permissions, workflows, and page layouts aligned to business requirements and internal controls.

Develop and support automation using SuiteFlow and, where applicable, SuiteScript to improve process efficiency and reduce manual work.

Optimize NetSuite modules and capabilities relevant to O2C, including SuiteBilling, Dunning, and Advanced Revenue Management.

Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks, control weaknesses, and data quality issues, and implement scalable improvements.

Support month-end and year-end close activities

Technical Support, Troubleshooting, and System Maintenance

Serve as a technical resource for diagnosing and resolving NetSuite issues related to O2C workflows, configurations, scripts, integrations, and transactional data.

Perform root-cause analysis on system issues and recommend durable corrective actions.

Help maintain overall system health through periodic reviews, testing, cleanup, and performance monitoring.

Perform system administration activities including user roles / permissions, configuration and ongoing platform maintenance

Reporting, Analytics & Integrations

Build and maintain saved searches, dashboards, and custom reports, , and other analytics to support operational visibility and business decision-making.

Support and monitor integrations between NetSuite and upstream/downstream business systems, including Salesforce and other connected platforms, using Boomi.

Troubleshoot integration issues, monitor exception handling, and help ensure reliable and accurate data flow across systems.

Document integration specifications, field mappings, technical dependencies and support procedures

Stakeholder Collaboration & Projects

Gather, document, and translate business requirements into system configurations and functional specifications.

Lead UAT, change management, and training for system enhancements and new rollouts.

Act as a key resource during internal and external audits related to O2C controls.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

2-5 years of hands-on NetSuite administration or business systems analyst experience.

Demonstrated expertise with NetSuite O2C modules: Advanced Revenue, Billing, Suitebilling, and Dunning

Proficiency in NetSuite SuiteFlow, saved searches, custom records, suite analytics and reporting.

Experience managing or contributing to system integrations (Celigo, or Boomi preferred).

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-improvement mindset.

Strong communication skills; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

NetSuite Administrator or SuiteFoundation certification.

Experience with Boomi and/or Celigo

SuiteScript 1.0/2.x development experience.

Prior experience in a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

Experience supporting NetSuite OneWorld multi-subsidiary environments.

title: Principal - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.

We’re transforming the software industry. We’re Flexera. With **more than 50,000 customers** across the world, we ’ re achieving that goal . But we know we can’t do any of that without our team . Job Description

The NetSuite Business Systems Analyst – Order to Cash (O2C) is a techno-functional role focused on the configuration, development, support, and optimization of Flexera’s NetSuite Order-to-Cash processes. This position serves as a key resource for designing and implementing system solutions across NetSuite, with responsibility for workflows, integrations, reporting, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform improvements.

  

The ideal candidate has a strong technical understanding of NetSuite and knows how to translate business needs into effective system configurations and enhancements. This is not an accounting role. It is a business systems position for someone who can work hands-on in NetSuite to improve automation, scalability, data quality, and operational effectiveness across the O2C cycle.

  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

NetSuite O2C & Optimization

Configure, enhance, and support NetSuite functionality across the Order-to-Cash process, including customer setup, order management, billing, collections, and revenue-related workflows.

Design, build, and maintain NetSuite configurations such as custom fields, forms, records, roles, permissions, workflows, and page layouts aligned to business requirements and internal controls.

Develop and support automation using SuiteFlow and, where applicable, SuiteScript to improve process efficiency and reduce manual work.

Optimize NetSuite modules and capabilities relevant to O2C, including SuiteBilling, Dunning, and Advanced Revenue Management.

Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks, control weaknesses, and data quality issues, and implement scalable improvements.

Support month-end and year-end close activities

  

Technical Support, Troubleshooting, and System Maintenance

Serve as a technical resource for diagnosing and resolving NetSuite issues related to O2C workflows, configurations, scripts, integrations, and transactional data.

Perform root-cause analysis on system issues and recommend durable corrective actions.

Help maintain overall system health through periodic reviews, testing, cleanup, and performance monitoring.

Perform system administration activities including user roles / permissions, configuration and ongoing platform maintenance

  

Reporting, Analytics & Integrations

Build and maintain saved searches, dashboards, and custom reports, , and other analytics to support operational visibility and business decision-making.

Support and monitor integrations between NetSuite and upstream/downstream business systems, including Salesforce and other connected platforms, using Boomi.

Troubleshoot integration issues, monitor exception handling, and help ensure reliable and accurate data flow across systems.

Document integration specifications, field mappings, technical dependencies and support procedures

  

Stakeholder Collaboration & Projects

Gather, document, and translate business requirements into system configurations and functional specifications.

Lead UAT, change management, and training for system enhancements and new rollouts.

Act as a key resource during internal and external audits related to O2C controls.

  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

2-5 years of hands-on NetSuite administration or business systems analyst experience.

Demonstrated expertise with NetSuite O2C modules: Advanced Revenue, Billing, Suitebilling, and Dunning

Proficiency in NetSuite SuiteFlow, saved searches, custom records, suite analytics and reporting.

Experience managing or contributing to system integrations (Celigo, or Boomi preferred).

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-improvement mindset.

Strong communication skills; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

NetSuite Administrator or SuiteFoundation certification.

Experience with Boomi and/or Celigo

SuiteScript 1.0/2.x development experience.

Prior experience in a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

Experience supporting NetSuite OneWorld multi-subsidiary environments.

Support

title: Associate Salesforce Systems Administrator - US Shift
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

### **What's in it for you?**

**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**  
Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**  
There are plenty of sales jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.

  

**Role Summary (Impact in this Role): Objective / Purpose of the Position**

The Salesforce System Support Specialist is responsible for performing general declarative Salesforce administrative duties, assisting with the ongoing maintenance and development of our Salesforce instance, helping to deliver high-quality enhancements, and providing 1st tier support for the organization. A Salesforce Admin provides day-to-day support, administration of Salesforce, maintain data cleanliness, and will generate/analyze simple to complex reports.

**Areas of Responsibility: Essential Functions**

  

* Manage Salesforce continuous improvement projects end to end, coordinating cross-functionally as necessary to gather requirements, ideate and decide upon solution paths, implementation and testing.
* Identify areas for improvement and cross-functional dependencies. Brainstorm solutions and suggest optimal solution path.
* Gains a deep understanding of sales systems and processes and provides insights into the impact of any potential configuration changes.
* Manage Salesforce configuration projects, including (but not limited to): Declarative Automation, objects, fields, page layouts, record types, custom settings, dashboards, and reports.
* Assist with onboarding and project training/enablement for sales tools and processes.
* Generates and analyzes simple and complex reports from Salesforce based on business needs as requested by the sales and sales management team
* Provides day-to-day support and administration for Salesforce
* Manage all aspects of user and license management including new user setup/deactivation, roles, profiles, permissions, public groups
* Maintains data cleanliness, identifies, and resolves data inaccuracies within our systems
* User support tickets
* Bulk data management
* Manage deal desk processes

  

**Preferred Experience/Qualifications**

  

* 0-5 years of professional experience as a Salesforce Administrator
* 4-year degree in Information Technology or Computer Science. Degrees in similar analytical areas of study will also be considered.
* Salesforce Admin Certification is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team are essential.
* A successful candidate will also exhibit a strong desire to learn and understand all aspects of the company's operations and be able to interact directly with other departments.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server or academic study of SQL is preferred.
* Ability to travel 0-10% annually in the U.S. for team meetings, offsites, etc.

We're actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Mainframe CICS Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

Success in this role means delivering a secure, highly available, and high-performing CICS environment that supports mission-critical business applications while driving modernization, automation, and operational excellence.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, administer, and support IBM CICS Transaction Server environments across enterprise z/OS platforms.
* Perform CICS upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and lifecycle management while ensuring platform stability, availability, and security.
* Manage and support CICS regions, including AOR, TOR, FOR, COR, and complex CICSplex environments.
* Monitor, analyze, and optimize transaction performance, response times, CPU utilization, storage consumption, and workload distribution.
* Configure and maintain CICS resources, system definitions, startup procedures, CSD/BAS definitions, and operational infrastructure.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery readiness through proactive capacity planning, recovery testing, and business continuity strategies.
* Administer and support CICS security controls in partnership with RACF and security teams, including transaction, program, command, resource, and surrogate security.
* Support enterprise connectivity and integration technologies such as MQ, EXCI, DPL, MRO, ISC, IPIC, Web Services, REST APIs, and TCP/IP.
* Serve as the highest level technical escalation point for critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, dump and trace analysis, and resolution of complex CICS abends and system issues.
* Collaborate with application development teams to support testing, deployments, modernization initiatives, and production support for business-critical applications.
* Lead strategic initiatives including CICS TS upgrades, API enablement, modernization programs, hybrid cloud integration, DevOps adoption, and observability enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, System Automation, NetView, and OPS/MVS to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
* Administer monitoring and observability platforms such as OMEGAMON, MainView, Dynatrace, Tivoli, SMF, and RMF to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, architectural guidance, and best practices to system programmers, engineers, and support teams.
Ensure compliance with operational, security, audit, and service delivery standards while driving continuous improvement across the CICS platform.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 8+ years of relevant hands-on experience in Mainframe CICS System Programming or CICS infrastructure support.
* Good working knowledge of IBM CICS Transaction Server, including CICS regions, system configuration, administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting CICS production environments, including incident resolution, service requests, planned changes, and system maintenance activities.
* Working knowledge of CICS installation, maintenance, upgrades, or migration activities.
* Experience or exposure to CICS-related IBM and third-party products and monitoring tools such as IBM OMEGAMON for CICS, BMC MainView, ASG TMON/CICS, CICS Performance Analyzer, Abend-AID, Xpediter/CICS, InterTest, SymDump, or similar products.
* Understanding of CICS integration with technologies such as IBM MQ, Db2, VSAM, and other Mainframe application components.
* Working knowledge of CICS performance monitoring, transaction analysis, region health monitoring, and basic performance troubleshooting.
Ability and willingness to participate in rotational on-call support, planned maintenance activities, and Disaster Recovery exercises as required.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Exposure to CICS Web Services, API enablement, Java integration, or other CICS modernization technologies.
* Experience supporting CICS maintenance using SMP/E and applying IBM PTFs, APAR fixes, or related maintenance.
* Exposure to CICSplex System Manager, CICSPlex SM, Workload Management, or multi-region CICS environments.
* Experience with CICS performance analysis, workload balancing, capacity monitoring, or tuning activities.
Ability to contribute effectively to projects, upgrades, migrations, maintenance activities, and continuous improvement initiatives as part of a broader technical team.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As a **Public Cloud Solutions Architect** at Kyndryl, you act as the trusted advisor who turns business goals into cloud architecture that actually ships. You work closely with client executives, enterprise architects, security and compliance teams, governance, delivery, and our hyperscaler partners to keep everyone aligned on one technical direction. You get involved early, helping shape the strategy and the migration and modernization roadmap, and you stay through delivery so the architecture goes live on time, on budget, and secure by design.

This is a senior, client-facing role. **To the client, you are the go-to expert on public cloud.** You run discovery and assessment workshops, build the business case and total cost of ownership, and translate requirements into well-architected solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Increasingly, that means designing for AI and agentic AI as well, from the data and platform foundations through to the workloads themselves.

  

You will decide what Kyndryl will deliver, design the landing zones, networking, identity, data, and application patterns behind it, and lead the implementation teams to a clean result.

Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

* Experience applying AI to the delivery itself, using AI-led approaches, automation, and agentic tooling to speed up assessment, migration, modernization, and quality assurance

* Familiarity with hybrid and on-premises-to-cloud platforms (VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, AWS Outposts, Azure Stack/Arc, Google Distributed Cloud)
* Deeper specialization in agentic AI, such as multi-agent systems, agent orchestration and governance (AgentOps), retrieval-augmented generation, and integrating large language models into enterprise workflows and platforms

Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:

Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* **Golden paths:** build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* **AI Agentic automation:** Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* **Compliance:** keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* **Toolchain rationalisation:** be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - DB
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - DB builds and runs Database Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.

Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall, 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Strong experience as Database Engineer and/or Architect
* Deep understanding of Relational Database technologies (MSSQL, PostgreSQL)
* Understanding of modern database & storage technologies (NoSQL, Caching Services, Time-Series Database, Vector Database, Spatial Database)
* Experience as a DBA
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE

  

* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* undefined
* Familiarity and hands on with Traditional Database Products (Oracle)
* undefined
* Knowledge of cloud cost methodology.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Administration, Database Architecture, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, NoSQL, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Times Series, Vector Databases, Virtualization

title: Mainframe zOS Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade **DB2 for z/OS** environments, ensuring platform stability, performance, and availability.
* Plan and execute DB2 version migrations, maintenance activities, and recovery strategies, including SMP/E, PTF, and APAR implementations.
* Administer DB2 subsystems, DSNZPARM configurations, buffer pools, storage resources, catalogs, and directories.
* Monitor, analyze, and optimize DB2 performance through tuning of subsystem parameters, SQL access paths, buffer pools, and resource utilization.
* Design and support high-availability, disaster recovery, and data-sharing environments to meet business continuity and recovery objectives.
* Manage DB2 utilities including REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY, LOAD/UNLOAD, RECOVER, and REBUILD INDEX operations while ensuring optimal execution and reliability.
* Partner with security teams to implement DB2 security controls, authorization strategies, compliance requirements, and vulnerability remediation.
* Perform capacity planning, growth forecasting, and infrastructure optimization to support evolving business and application demands.
* Develop and enhance automation using REXX, JCL, and monitoring tools to improve operational efficiency and proactive system health management.
* Lead root cause analysis and resolution of critical incidents, acting as the highest level of technical escalation for complex DB2 issues.
* Collaborate with application development teams on SQL tuning, database design reviews, migrations, and onboarding of new workloads.
* Drive modernization initiatives including DB2 upgrades, DevOps integration, automation, observability enhancements, cloud connectivity, and mainframe transformation programs.
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, operational governance, and strategic guidance to ensure a secure, highly available, and high-performing DB2 infrastructure.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

title: Sr. Analyst Source to Pay (S2P) Systems – Coupa
description:

* Review major release notes for The Source-to-Pay (S2P) System and provide delta assessment and impacts.
