* Partner with Integration teams responsible for development and support of The Source-to-Pay (S2P) System integrations with interfacing systems.
* Perform day-to-day tasks that involve ongoing support of the system.
* Promotes user adoption by improving usability.
* Responsible for first contact resolution (FCR) for user raised questions and issues, maintaining always a sense of urgency, providing excellent user experience and efficiency
* Support business requirements gathering, enhancement requests, and defect resolution by documenting needs and helping define practical solutions.
* Utilize strong functional knowledge across Source to Pay functions, including supplier on-boarding, purchase requisitioning, sourcing, invoicing, and payables.
* Create a positive business relationship with key business stakeholders
* Maintain relationship with the Regional Super Users of The Source-to-Pay (S2P) System
* Influence up / downstream processes with Executive leaders, peers, and suppliers
* Utilizes reporting tools to write, maintain and support a variety of reports or queries. Helps maintain data integrity in systems by running queries and analyzing data. Develop standard reports for ongoing needs and ad hoc queries as needed, working with staff to identify information requirements.
* Mass updates of data in Coupa through Postman APIs.
* Prioritize and escalate issues efficiently for prompt resolution
* Troubleshoot and resolve any integration related issues between Coupa and other systems in the landscape, such as ERP’s and Master Data tools.

Minimum Requirements

* Experience with Source-to-Pay (S2P) platforms such as Leading ERP (S2P) modules, Coupa, Ariba, Catalyst or Smart by GEP as a technical owner, implementer, or system administrator with strong functional knowledge. Coupa experience mandatory.
* Demonstrated track record of establishing priorities and meeting deadlines.
* Experience in troubleshooting system issues and working with other groups to prioritize and resolve the issues
* Experience in ServiceNow, SAP, Iscala, Navision is good to have
* Experience in Process Improvement
* Fluent in excel, word, etc.
* Experience with API with Coupa is a plus.
* Sound critical thinking and attention to details
* Acting as a liaison between internal associates and external suppliers to resolve concerns
* Fluent in English
* Familiarity with compliance and governance controls.
* Preferred – Finance and or Procurement background
* Preferred – Experienced in multi-system landscape support
* BA or BS degree in Business, Finance, IT with 8+ years of equivalent work experience into Coupa Admin.

We're looking for a **Senior** **Salesforce Security Architect** to define, design, and govern the security architecture of our enterprise Salesforce ecosystem. The role will establish scalable security patterns and controls across identity and access management, data protection, application security, integrations, monitoring, compliance, and emerging Salesforce capabilities.

The architect will partner with Enterprise Security, Salesforce platform teams, application development teams, business stakeholders, and compliance teams to ensure Salesforce solutions follow enterprise security requirements and the principles of least privilege, defense in depth, secure-by-design, and auditable access.

  
Responsibilities:

**Security Architecture & Governance**

* Define and maintain the Salesforce security architecture, standards, patterns, and guardrails.
* Perform security architecture reviews for new Salesforce solutions, integrations, and major platform changes.
* Identify security risks and recommend appropriate technical controls and remediation strategies.
* Ensure security architecture aligns with enterprise cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Provide security guidance to Salesforce administrators, developers, architects, and delivery teams.

**Data Security & Privacy**

* Define approaches for protecting confidential and sensitive information stored in Salesforce.
* Establish data classification and protection standards.
* Review data access patterns and prevent inappropriate exposure of sensitive information.
* Provide security architecture for data movement between Salesforce and downstream/upstream enterprise systems.

**Salesforce Shield & Security Monitoring**

* Architect and govern the use of Salesforce Shield capabilities.
* Define security monitoring and auditing requirements using Event Monitoring and platform audit capabilities.
* Establish integration patterns between Salesforce security events and enterprise SIEM/security-monitoring platforms.

**Secure Development & DevSecOps**

* Partner with development teams to identify security vulnerabilities during solution design and implementation.
* Incorporate security reviews into Salesforce development and release processes.
* Drive remediation of security findings and technical security debt.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 9–15 years of enterprise IT/application experience, with substantial hands-on Salesforce architecture and security experience.
* Strong expertise in Salesforce security architecture and access-control models.

* Experience conducting architecture/security reviews for enterprise Salesforce implementations.
* Understanding of secure software-development and DevSecOps principles.
* Experience with Salesforce Shield and enterprise SIEM/security-monitoring solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work across Security, IT Architecture, Engineering and business teams.

Du lundi au jeudi, travaillez sur site avec vos collègues. Le vendredi, choisissez votre lieu de travail, en tenant compte des exigences de votre activité.

EPM Regional Support Leads are part of the Strategic Reporting Systems team, which manages the global Enterprise Performance Management solution (OneStream , Oracle HFM, Planning and Analytics Cloud) for Trane Technologies, supporting over 700 users in their Actuals reporting and consolidation, as well as their Budgeting and Forecasting processes.

Regional Support Leads are responsible for the Enterprise Performance Management Customer Support, Training, Access Administration and Communication for their area of responsibility. * Challenge current practice and suggest new ways of working, value-added ideas/ approaches
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects with varying deadlines.
* Ability to prioritize with minimal supervision and interact with employees at all levels.
* Must be a self-starter and be able to work independently or as part of a team.
* Excellent, creative problem-solving skills.
* Experience with business process flow and cause-effect diagramming and analysis.
* Strong collaborative skills and ability to work in a dynamic fast paced environment.
* Excellent verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.

title: JBPIND - Administrator, Salesforce.
description:
Company Overview
  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is a subsidiary of J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. a privately held diversified manufacturing company forecasting $2.5B in annual revenue and 8,500 team members in 2026. The eight operating subsidiaries, covering over 50 locations, are engaged in the production of commercial truck bodies, step-vans, utility trucks, funeral coaches, limousines, pickup truck bed enclosures, precision machining, and expandable foam plastic packaging. For more information, visit www.jbpoindexter.com
  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is the captive shared services unit of the J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. The company, wholly owned by J. B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. & is headquartered in Houston, Texas, USA.
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The Salesforce.com Administrator (SFDC Sr. Admin) will support Salesforce.com requests and projects for business units across the JBPCO family of companies, particularly in Sales and Service Clouds, under the direction of the Director, SFDC Centre of Excellence.
  
The role is responsible for identifying, documenting potential solutions, and then implementing new and revised functionality in SFDC. This will involve configuration changes, flows, reports, dashboards, and integrations with other systems. The SFDC Admin will work as part of a team, and their role on each project could be different (administrator, developer, and/or tester). The role will handle some of the most complex/technical projects required by the business units of the JBPCO family of companies and will have to work effectively with the rest of the SFDC Centre of Excellence, corporate IT, and vendors.
  
  
**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Make configuration changes in SFDC sandboxes to satisfy documented requirements
* Perform testing of SFDC changes
* Peer review technical requirements and configuration changes of team members
* Deploy changes to production environments, and provide support for recent deployments
* Perform data mass updates using the SFDC Dataloader or Setup utilities (as applies)
* Build or revise SFDC Flows to satisfy project requirements
* Build and maintain SFDC reports and dashboards
* SFDC help desk support – identify sources of issue raised by business users, and implement solutions, as appropriate - Level 2/Level 3 production support
* Collect and document business requirements for assigned projects (as necessary)

**EXPERTISE REQUIRED/MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* Bachelor’s degree (minimum)
* 5-8 years of experience working with Salesforce.com, ideally with Salesforce Advanced Admin Certification or Salesforce Business Analyst certification, and/or Ranger status on Trailhead
* 5 - 8 years working projects in the Salesforce.com ecosystem and/or with sales/marketing in the manufacturing industry
* Strong communication skills
* High verbal and written proficiency in English

**Code of Ethics:**  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited, requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and authorities. This position shall actively ensure that his/her own activities and those of all employees within the project meet this obligation. JBPCO critical standards and procedures related to expected conduct are detailed on the company website. This position is expected to be familiar with these policies and ensure that they are implemented in all areas of control.

title: SAP RISE with SAP & BTP Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

The role will provide end-to-end technical coverage for SAP platforms, including system administration, installations/upgrades, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, transport/change management, scheduling, cloud infrastructure, and operational automation.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in SAP Basis and a good understanding of modern SAP cloud technologies and enterprise scheduling/change-management tools.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

Lead and support **RISE with SAP / SAP S/4HANA Cloud transformation and migration projects** .

Define and implement SAP cloud adoption and transformation strategies aligned with business requirements.

Provide technical expertise across **SAP BTP services and capabilities** .

Design and implement integrations between SAP S/4HANA and SAP/non-SAP applications using SAP BTP.

Work with **SAP Integration Suite** , including Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, and related integration capabilities.

Support **SAP Extension Suite / side-by-side extensibility** using SAP BTP.

Evaluate existing SAP customizations and identify opportunities for **clean-core adoption** .

Support SAP S/4HANA migration, system integration, technical architecture, and cloud adoption activities.

Collaborate with SAP functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Define integration architecture, interfaces, APIs, data flows, and security requirements.

Work with SAP Cloud Connector, identity and access management, and connectivity between on-premise and cloud environments.

Participate in architecture reviews, solution design, technical estimations, and project planning.

Troubleshoot complex SAP integration, connectivity, and cloud-platform issues.

Ensure adherence to SAP best practices, security standards, development guidelines, and clean-core principles.

Coordinate with SAP, implementation partners, and other technology teams during project delivery.

Prepare technical documentation, architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and operational procedures.

Provide technical leadership and mentor junior SAP team members.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* **8+ years of overall SAP experience** with significant experience in SAP technical/solution architecture.
* Hands-on experience with **RISE with SAP** and SAP S/4HANA Cloud transformation/migration programs.
* Strong working knowledge of **SAP BTP** and its key services.
* Experience with **SAP Integration Suite / CPI (Cloud Integration)** .
* Experience with **API Management, SAP Cloud Connector, and SAP connectivity concepts** .
* Understanding of **SAP S/4HANA architecture and clean-core principles** .
* Experience designing integrations between SAP and third-party applications.
* Strong understanding of **REST APIs, OData, SOAP, JSON/XML** , and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with SAP security, authentication, authorization, and identity concepts.
* Understanding of SAP cloud architecture and hyperscaler environments such as **AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud** is desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of SAP implementation and support methodologies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.  

  
  

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* SAP BTP certification(s).
* SAP S/4HANA certification.
* Experience with **SAP Build, SAP Extension Suite, SAP Event Mesh** , or other BTP services.
* Experience with **SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud** .
* Knowledge of **ABAP on BTP / ABAP Cloud** .
* Experience with SAP Fiori/UI5 and modern SAP development practices.
* Experience working with **SAP Activate methodology** .
* Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD, Git, and automated deployment practices.
* Experience with SAP Business Network or other SAP cloud solutions.
* Experience working on large-scale global SAP transformation programs.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* SAP certifications in **S/4HANA, BTP, Integration Suite, or related technologies** are preferred.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer - NCS Telecom Implementation
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Assume a vital position as a key member of a high-performing team that delivers infrastructure and performance excellence. Your role will be instrumental in shaping the future at one of the world's largest and most influential companies.
  
  
As a Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you will play a critical role in building, and optimizing the infrastructure platforms that support our global operations. You will drive technical strategy, mentor fellow engineers, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver highly available, secure, and performant systems. Your expertise will directly influence how we scale our technology to meet evolving business demands.

**Job responsibilities**

* Orchestrate post-order carrier milestones across the delivery lifecycle; track progress, identify risks, and drive mitigation to keep delivery predictable.
* Coordinate install and cutover execution, including site/provider scheduling, internal handoffs, maintenance windows, and execution readiness.
* Plan and execute testing aligned to agreed acceptance criteria; capture and manage test evidence and implementation exceptions through to resolution or documented acceptance.
* Complete BAU handover with closure evidence and required metadata; ensure documentation quality supports operational readiness and auditability.
* Execute decommission/disconnect activities where in scope, with appropriate governance and closure evidence.
* Partner with the Demand Managers for customer-facing status communications, providing accurate milestone updates, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with telecom providers, vendors, and internal engineering teams end-to-end – from design through acceptance testing and BAU handover – driving performance against SLAs.
* Manage change control inputs, cost governance inputs, and documentation hygiene across connectivity implementations.
* Strongly considers upstream and downstream data and systems or technical implications and advises on mitigation actions
* Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within delivery and automation routines to identify recurring issues and validate remediation options, ensuring changes are traceable/auditable and aligned to resiliency and security expectations.
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate infrastructure analysis and design documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Proven implementation delivery / service delivery experience, within a global financial or regulated enterprise environment.
* Deep knowledge of networking and telecommunications technologies (Layers 0–3), including dark fiber, DWDM, Ethernet, IP-VPN, DIA, broadband, cellular, and satellite connectivity.
* Experience coordinating delivery with telecom service providers and managed service providers, including contract and SLA oversight.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trust across business and technical domains.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations across geographies.
* Working familiarity with cloud connectivity and hybrid architectures (e.g., public cloud on-ramps, private connectivity patterns) and how they impact implementation planning and testing.
* Deep knowledge of one or more areas of infrastructure engineering such as: hardware, networking terminology, databases, storage engineering, deployment practices, integration, automation, scaling, resilience or performance assessments
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations.
* Deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure and multiple cloud technologies with the ability to operate in and migrate across public and private clouds

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience using Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence) for workflow, documentation, reporting, and closure evidence management.
* Familiarity with cloud connectivity and hybrid architectures.
* Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator).
* Data analytical skills – ability to interrogate, model, and visualize delivery datasets to identify trends, cost drivers, and delivery risks.
* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience leveraging AI and automation to streamline service delivery workflows.

**ABOUT US**

title: Senior Identity Engineer - IT Risk and Security
description:
Overview:

**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  
  
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Business Segment Overview**

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

**Position Purpose:** As Senior Identity Engineer for IT Risk and Security, you will be a senior hands-on engineer responsible for operating, improving, automating, securing and troubleshooting the enterprise identity platforms the firm depends on. The estate of platforms include Identity Providers, legacy directory services, enterprise PKI, privileged access management, modern authentication and identity governance tooling, alongside legacy platforms now being retired. This is a senior individual contributor role, not an architect role — the ideal candidate is deeply hands-on, comfortable owning complex, ambiguous identity problems end to end with minimal supervision, and raises the standard of the engineers around them. Experience working in a regulated financial environment is a plus.

Responsibilities:

**Primary duties will include:**

* Design, build and operate identity services across core identity provider platforms—Entra ID with hybrid directory services and Okta—including authentication journeys, application integration, federation and single sign-on at scale; implement, test, troubleshoot and monitor access policies, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, authentication strengths, session controls, policy exclusions and emergency access safeguards.
* Operate and troubleshoot Active Directory in large, complex, multi-domain and multi-forest environments, including domain controllers, DNS and name resolution, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts and cross-domain authentication, service accounts, privileged groups, delegated access and domain health; coordinate changes across dependent systems.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex identity incidents — authentication failures, provisioning issues, certificate-related outages, privileged access problems and production change failures — determining cause, escalating anything with ongoing or immediate impact, performing root cause analysis and driving the problem to a permanent fix.
* Plan, execute, validate and document production identity changes, including risk assessment, implementation steps, rollback planning, stakeholder coordination, functional and connectivity testing, and post-change monitoring.
* Grow the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle — provisioning and deprovisioning driven from authoritative HR sources, and policy and role-based entitlement in place of ticket-by-ticket approval.
* Support PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services — TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Automate repeatable identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, source control and pipeline-based workflows, applying configuration-as-code to identity change rather than manual administration.
* Develop group policies and access control lists, design and build system administration and management functionality for privileged access users, maintain baseline system security, and resolve vulnerabilities in identity systems and components through documented remediation plans.
* Maintain the resilience of the service: define availability levels, determine disaster recovery and continuity of operations requirements, and develop, test and execute recovery and alternate-site procedures for identity platforms.
* Own operational documentation for the identity services you support — SOPs, runbooks, implementation records, troubleshooting guides, escalation procedures, known-error documentation and workflow diagrams — kept current with the deployed design and to a standard that allows work to move between regions without loss.
* Produce audit-ready evidence for identity controls — privileged access, access reviews, account lifecycle events, group membership, policy changes, app permissions, certificate ownership and remediation actions — supporting internal audit, external audit and client or scheme assessments including SWIFT CSP, defending design decisions and closing findings to agreed dates.
* Collect metrics and trending data, develop cybersecurity and performance success metrics, and examine service performance reports for issues and variances so identity risk is visible without a manual data pull.
* Mentor and upskill engineers across the team through code and design reviews, interactive training and knowledge transfer, building genuine cover so that every platform has more than one engineer, in more than one region, who can safely operate it.
* Establish internal and external cross-team relationships — with security architecture, security operations, enterprise IT, HR, compliance and application teams — to gather requirements, translate proposed capabilities into technical requirements and deliver identity solutions that meet business needs.

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need:**

* This individual must be capable of working with internal and customer-facing teams to facilitate process improvement and customer support resulting in an enhanced security posture, reduction in risk and improvement in end-user experience. Excellent communication, strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential.
* 5+ years in identity and access management in a hands-on engineering or operations role, with a track record of independently delivering complex identity change in a large, distributed estate; experience in financial services a plus.
* Deep, current, hands-on experience operating Active Directory in large, complex environments — domain controllers, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts, service accounts, privileged groups and domain health troubleshooting — including multi-domain or multi-forest estates with cross-domain authentication and delegated access.
* Equivalent depth in Microsoft Entra ID — tenant configuration, directory synchronization, conditional access, privileged role management, entitlement models, enterprise applications and app registrations — and in Okta, covering policy architecture, authentication journeys, application integration, lifecycle management and federation at scale.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across authentication, authorization, federation, directory synchronization, MFA, Conditional Access, certificates, DNS, LDAP, Kerberos, SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SCIM.
* Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services, including TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated experience governing non-human identities — service accounts, managed identities, app registrations, API clients and automation accounts — including secrets and certificate handling, ownership records, permission reviews and decommissioning.
* Strong automation ability using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, including the Okta management APIs, with practical use of source control, pipelines and configuration-as-code applied to identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation.
* Knowledge and implementation of key security concepts such as RBAC, zero trust, identity lifecycle automation, least privilege and identity governance.
* Expert command of change management process and discipline; you are expected to plan, document and execute high-risk identity change on production platforms with minimal guidance, including rollback planning and post-change validation.
* Demonstrated operational engineering discipline: incident, problem and change management, root cause analysis, service level reporting, and the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, runbooks and known-error documentation.
* Direct experience supporting identity controls through audit — preparing evidence, defending design decisions to auditors or regulators, and closing findings.
* Understanding of a broad range of general information security domains, including networking, cybersecurity, governance and risk, and cloud.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, sufficient to explain identity design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, answer requests for information directly, and communicate critical or time-sensitive information to leadership.
* Experience with a cohesive PAM/IGA program

**What makes you stand out**:

* You have an engineer's instinct; you see an inefficient process and immediately think of how to automate it away rather than staff it.
* You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are comfortable carrying live service ownership and a delivery backlog at the same time.
* You are equally comfortable in both platforms and can reason about where a capability belongs — Entra ID or Okta — rather than defaulting to the one you know best.
* You are the person others escalate to, and you close the loop by documenting what you found so the next engineer does not have to rediscover it.
* You leave the estate better documented and better understood than you found it, and you deliberately build capability in the engineers around you.
* You have experience in a Zero Trust program, or with securing non-human identities including service accounts, workload identities and emerging agentic and AI workloads.
* Education / Certification Requirements:
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information security or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) preferred.
* Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Administrator preferred; Okta Certified Consultant a plus.
* CISSP, CISM, CyberArk Defender or Sentry, or an equivalent identity governance credential preferred; ITIL foundation or equivalent service management training is a plus.
* Significant experience with demonstrated examples of growing PAM and/or IGA programs
* Production delivery experience across at least three of: identity governance and administration tooling, privileged access management such as CyberArk, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, federation and single sign-on, and multi-factor or passwordless authentication.

**Working environment**:

* Team distributed across UK, US and GCC locations; **expected business start time (2:00 - 2:30 PM IST) to overlap some of US business hours** and participation in an escalation and on-call rotation should be expected.
* 4 days' a week in office.

You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. The design manager in MEP will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP-related installation, site inspection and contractor management. Making visions come trueYou’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there. While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project. Building strong teams and business reputationOne of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities. Keeping risks at bayHow do you deal with risks? Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP-related management—including the development of MEP project plan and procedures and construction schedules? A business savvy leader who can walk the talkYou understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements. You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders. A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skillsAre you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients. Apply today!

title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Overview**  

The Microsoft Security organization’s mission of making the world a safer place has never been more important. As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we drive improvements into our security products that keep our customers, applications, and devices safe. Security is one of the fastest growing, highly collaborative teams with an entrepreneurial mindset within Microsoft.

The Microsoft Defender family offers comprehensive threat prevention, detection, and response capabilities for everyone – from individuals looking to protect their family to the world’s largest enterprises. Linux servers run highly business-critical workloads for our customers and are increasingly targeted by attackers seeking to disrupt those workloads. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides a security solution to help protect Linux servers with high performance, quality, and innovative security capabilities. We are hiring a Group Engineering Manager for this product area. Our work provides peace of mind to customers by helping them protect their critical assets.

Our team includes people from a wide variety of backgrounds, previous work experiences, and life journeys, and we are eager to maintain and grow that diversity. We are passionate about learning on the job, collaborating with other teams, and staying deeply focused on customer needs. Join us to build easy-to-use cybersecurity products that positively impact over a billion users from all walks of life.

  
**Responsibilities**

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead, mentor, and grow a talented and diverse team of engineers focused on delivering products that create deep customer value. You will partner with other Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional leaders to build a sustainable, high-performing team and foster an engineering culture focused on delivering products our customers love.

You will collaborate across teams to develop innovative solutions that protect Linux servers through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and contribute to the growth of the business. You will provide strong technical and people leadership, establish engineering rigor, foster a data- and results-driven culture, and build an environment of collaboration, inclusion, and trust.

You will also help drive the adoption and impact of Microsoft Security products while enabling your team to deliver high-quality solutions at scale.

If you are passionate about **Linux, cybersecurity, engineering excellence, and building high-performing teams**, this role offers an exciting opportunity to bring those passions together.

 **Qualifications**  

* **12+ years of experience in software engineering**, with experience building enterprise software and a proven track record of shipping commercially successful software products and services.
* Demonstrated ability to **lead, mentor, nurture, and grow engineering talent**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams comprising Software Engineers, Program Managers, Security Researchers, and Data Scientists.
* **3+ years of experience leading and building engineering teams**.
* **7+ years of experience designing and developing applications and systems on Linux**.
* **7+ years of experience applying software development principles, design patterns, and engineering best practices**.
* Strong understanding of **Linux internals** and experience building Linux-based products.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with **secure software development lifecycle (SDL) practices**.
* Experience with software development tools and systems, including source control systems such as Git, automated build systems, compilers, software validation systems, project tracking tools, and lifecycle management systems.
* Ability to work independently and drive complex **technical and architectural decisions and dependencies**.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience building **Linux kernel modules**.
* Contributions to **Linux open-source projects**, particularly in the kernel space.

**Role:** Snowflake DBA / Cloud Data Platform Administrator  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contractual (as per project requirement)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Snowflake Database Administrator (DBA)** with strong expertise in Snowflake administration, cloud infrastructure, database security, access management, release management, disaster recovery and operational support.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing enterprise Snowflake environments, implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), configuring network policies, managing production releases and performing periodic operational and security reviews.

The candidate should also possess working knowledge of **AWS EC2, S3, Linux, Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps pipelines and Medallion Architecture**.

Key Responsibilities1. Snowflake Database Administration

* Administer and maintain Snowflake environments across development, testing and production.
* Manage databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, users and access privileges.
* Monitor warehouse performance, resource utilization, query execution and storage consumption.
* Perform routine database health checks, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Support Snowflake configuration changes, upgrades and operational improvements.
* Manage Snowflake tasks, streams, stages and data-loading configurations.

2. Security, RBAC and Network Policies

* Implement and maintain Snowflake Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Configure and manage network policies, network rules and access restrictions.
* Administer user accounts, service accounts and access permissions.
* Perform periodic user-access reviews, privilege audits and security compliance checks.
* Troubleshoot authentication, authorization and connectivity issues.
* Support secure credential management and access governance.

3. Bundle Release Change (BCR) Management

* Participate in Bundle Release Change (BCR) activities.
* Coordinate and execute approved database configuration and release changes.
* Perform pre-deployment validation and post-deployment verification.
* Maintain change records, deployment documentation and rollback procedures.
* Coordinate release activities across development, QA, production and infrastructure teams.

4. Routine and Periodic Reviews

* Conduct daily, weekly and monthly Snowflake operational reviews.
* Review warehouse utilization, failed queries, scheduled jobs and system alerts.
* Perform periodic access, network policy and security configuration reviews.
* Identify operational risks, performance bottlenecks and recurring issues.
* Prepare review reports, audit evidence and operational documentation.

5. Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity

* Support Snowflake disaster recovery and business continuity procedures.
* Work with Snowflake Time Travel, Fail-safe concepts, database replication and failover capabilities.
* Participate in disaster recovery drills and recovery validation.
* Maintain recovery procedures and support RPO/RTO objectives.
* Investigate failures and support restoration of database services.

6. AWS Infrastructure Integration

* Work with AWS S3 buckets for Snowflake data ingestion and external stages.
* Understand IAM roles, bucket policies, storage integrations and access permissions.
* Support AWS EC2-based applications, utilities and connectivity requirements.
* Troubleshoot Snowflake-to-AWS connectivity and permission issues.
* Coordinate with cloud infrastructure teams on configuration and access management.

7. Linux Administration and Scheduling

* Perform basic Linux administration and troubleshooting.
* Work with Linux commands, file permissions, logs and shell scripts.
* Manage and troubleshoot basic crontab scheduling activities.
* Monitor scheduled scripts, jobs and operational tasks.

8. Azure Integration and DevOps

* Understand Azure Key Vault for secure storage and management of secrets.
* Possess basic knowledge of Azure DevOps pipelines and CI/CD processes.
* Support deployment and configuration activities involving Snowflake environments.
* Coordinate with DevOps teams for automation and secure release management.

9. Data Architecture and Integration

* Demonstrate understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver and Gold layers).
* Understand data ingestion, transformation, validation and consumption workflows.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to resolve data pipeline and integration issues.
* Support data governance, data quality and platform reliability initiatives.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* Minimum 5 years of relevant Snowflake DBA experience.
* Strong hands-on Snowflake database administration.
* Snowflake RBAC, roles, grants and access management.
* Snowflake network policies and security configuration.
* Bundle Release Change (BCR) and production change management.
* Routine and periodic database operational reviews.
* Disaster recovery, replication and recovery procedures.
* AWS S3 and EC2 working knowledge.
* Linux fundamentals and basic crontab operations.
* Azure Key Vault and basic Azure DevOps pipeline knowledge.
* Understanding of Medallion Architecture.
* Strong SQL and database troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Skills

* SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced certification.
* Experience with enterprise production Snowflake environments.
* Experience with AWS IAM, CloudWatch and cloud monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of Terraform, scripting or infrastructure automation.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, incident management and change management.
* Experience with audit compliance and security governance.
* Exposure to ETL/ELT pipelines and enterprise data platforms.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 years of total IT experience, including at least 5 years in Snowflake administration or closely related cloud data platform operations.
* Proven experience supporting production systems and resolving critical incidents.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and documentation capabilities.
* Ability to coordinate with cloud infrastructure, data engineering, security and DevOps teams.

Candidate Screening Criteria

Candidates must demonstrate practical experience in:

* Administering Snowflake production environments independently.
* Creating and managing RBAC roles, grants and network policies.
* Handling BCR, deployment validation and rollback procedures.
* Conducting routine reviews, access audits and disaster recovery activities.
* Configuring or supporting Snowflake integration with AWS S3.
* Using basic Linux commands and crontab.
* Working with Azure Key Vault and understanding Azure pipelines.
* Explaining Bronze, Silver and Gold layers in Medallion Architecture.

**Important:** Preference will be given to candidates with genuine Snowflake DBA production support experience rather than candidates whose experience is limited to Snowflake development, SQL programming or ETL development.

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

title: MF Platform Support-Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do

* Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
* Design, deploy, and integrate end-to-end infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments to ensure seamless operations.
* Automate workflows, processes, and system tasks to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational consistency.
* Assess technical risks proactively and implement preventive measures to minimize disruptions and maintain business continuity.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Architects, Project Managers, and technical specialists, to deliver successful project outcomes.
* Lead infrastructure projects from planning through execution, ensuring high-quality delivery within agreed timelines and customer expectations.
* Communicate technical solutions and architecture recommendations effectively to customers and stakeholders, building trust through measurable business impact.
Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise IT systems, and emerging technologies while pursuing professional certifications and career growth opportunities.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

title: Senior HRIS Admin (Workday Benefits & Absences)
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

**SUMMARY**  
Q2 is seeking an HRIS Administrator to serve as a functional and technical subject-matter expert for the Benefits and Absence modules within our Workday HCM platform. In this role you will own the day-to-day configuration, administration, and integrity of these modules while partnering closely with Total Rewards, Benefits, and Leave Administration leadership to deliver a seamless employee experience. This role works as a paired backup with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator, so experience with Workday Payroll and Time Tracking is a plus. You bring proven Workday hands-on expertise and are motivated to drive continuous improvement across the HR technology landscape.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Systems Analysis, Configuration & Technical Excellence**

* Maintain and administer Workday Benefits and Absence modules, including benefit plans, eligibility rules, open enrollment and life event configuration, leave plans, and accrual rules; serve as the primary functional and technical expert for these domains.
* Design and configure multi-step business processes, and lead end-to-end testing cycles for annual open enrollment, plan year changes, and leave policy updates, confirming downstream impacts with stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Workday configuration, calculation, and reporting issues by designing durable fixes and evaluating cross-system impacts using systems thinking.
* Provide backup support for Payroll and Time Tracking module administration, partnering with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator to ensure continuity of coverage.

**Data Integrity & Quality**

* Ensure data accuracy and system integrity across Benefits and Absence, including enrollment audits, deduction reconciliation with Payroll, and carrier and vendor eligibility reconciliation; lead audit data work and implement data quality improvements.
* Write, maintain, and support standard and custom Workday reports and dashboards; ensure system outputs comply with controls and proactively surface insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive system documentation, including configuration workbooks, test results, and help guides across all assigned modules.

**Integrations & Vendor Partnership**

* Support and monitor benefits carrier and vendor integrations (such as medical, dental, vision, 401(k), HSA/FSA, and leave management vendors); resolve file errors, eligibility discrepancies, and enrollment mismatches.
* Partner with benefits brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators on annual plan changes, regulatory updates, and data feed requirements.

**Process Optimization, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Review, assess, and recommend improvements to HRIS workflows, user experience, and system processes; design scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and drive operational efficiency.
* Design and implement multi-step automations that streamline HR workflows; integrate AI-enabled tools to improve accuracy and delivery speed.
* Develop and maintain end-user procedures, guidelines, training materials, and documentation; own training design and delivery for open enrollment, system updates, and platform change readiness.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Partnership**

* Lead requirements definition and solution validation with HR, Benefits, Leave Administration, Payroll, and business stakeholders; serve as a trusted advisor recommending system improvements grounded in user feedback and business needs.
* Lead project workstreams for Workday module implementations and enhancements, aligning system decisions to project goals and driving cross-functional alignment.
* Facilitate strong business partnerships with internal stakeholders, keeping all relevant parties informed, enabling meaningful feedback loops, and representing the HR Technology team with excellence.

**EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5+ years of HRIS experience with a strong focus on Workday Benefits and Absence module configuration and administration.
* Strong understanding of HCM design, structure, functions, and processes, including business process workflows, advanced reporting capabilities, and overall system compliance.

* Working knowledge of the following HR business domains: Payroll and Time Tracking, including wage and hour regulations (such as FLSA and state and local requirements) and payroll tax concepts.

* Adhere to uniform guidelines and maintain a professional appearance as per Brik Oven

* Ensure that each individual sections are prepared according to Brik Oven standards to ensure

customer readiness.

* Monitor and maintain the physical infrastructure of the restaurant.
* Ensure cleanliness and safety standards are upheld.
* Address any maintenance issues promptly.
* Adherence to the coffee station standards.

* To read and write at a beginner level, and to speak at an intermediate level in English.
* 10th Standard completed; additional certification in hospitality is a plus.
* Proven experience in restaurant operations or a similar role.
* Ability to maintain a presentable and well-groomed appearance in accordance with hygiene

* Communication and presentation skills

title: Regulatory Reporting, Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

  

We are looking for a candidates with 12+ Years of experience in Regulatory Reporting ( MIFID / EMIR/SFTR ). To be successful in this role, candidates should have a strong understanding of financial products, derivatives markets, and trading strategies, as well as familiarity with regulatory reporting requirements and data analysis tools. Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work well under pressure are also essential. A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field is typically required, along with several years of relevant work experience.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets. When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSGM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.

Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

  
  

**What you will be responsible for**

  

As Regulatory Reporting, Assistant Vice President you will

  
  

The Regulatory Reporting team has the responsibility of ensuring SSM meets itself as well as delegating reporting obligations under EMIR, MiFID, CFTC and SFTR. The team has the responsibility to report the FX and SF transactions emanating from its various trading venues.

  
  

* Proactively scrutinize E2E (end-to-end) deliverables of your vertical and ensure completion of all tasks pertaining to each jurisdiction
* Comprehensive management and monitoring of team deliverables
* Be the most erudite subject matter expert across regulations, process, system architecture, contact points and products
* Operate as the Checker of process and exception management, ensure all Checker activities are performed with sincerity and credibly evidenced
* Be the penultimate implementer of Governance and Controls within Regulatory Reporting process; explore AI capabilities that could eradicate all human and operational risk
* Plug all loopholes which can potentially result into any negative ramifications from Regulators and Auditors
* Take ownership and ensure accuracy and timely maintenance of all SOPS, Checklists, Controls, Error Logs, KPIs and KRIs always
* Absolute Ownership and Accountability of the team deliverables
* Regular engagement with directs as well as skip level employees
* Create an atmosphere of fairness and trust within team where everyone can approach you and share their concerns and challenges without any fear of illegitimate rebuttal
* Devote time to the weakest members of the team, mentor them proficiently and aid them to come up the curve
* Walk the talk, demonstrate the qualities and performance yourself what you preach to people
* Establish credible network with peers and seniors across local and global locations
* Imbibe and reflect State Street cultural traits and values in day-to-day duties
* Establish a culture of continuous learning, improvement, excellence and proactive ideation capabilities within the team
* Create apposite backups for self as well as pivotal members of the team, ensure there is enough fungibility across resources to cater to contingency situations
* Be the primary point of contact of stakeholders preceding the VP, any queries, concerns or requests raised for or within your vertical needs to be routed via you
* Must have in depth functional knowledge on the complete periphery of products and regulations within the gamut of Regulatory Reporting
* Proactively drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline operating models, gain efficiency, identify and mitigate control gaps by improving existing process
* Work closely with Ops team in collaboration with Technology, Product Owners and Change Management teams to enrich the process and implant strategies for tomorrow
  

  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  
  

* Communicates effectively and accurately in English
* Strong leadership, management, and organizational skills
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Team player
* Ability to work on own initiative
* Very good management skills
* Self- motivated, flexible, personable
* Good working knowledge of software packages, particularly Microsoft Excel
* Good interpersonal skills and an understanding of the rudimentary aspects of the global financial industry and also to FX Product, Securities Finance Product knowledge with Regulatory reporting of SFTR, EMIR, MIFID and CFTC would be advantageous.
  

  

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 12+ years of functional work experience in trade and transaction reporting operations - worked in one or more of the Regulations - CFTC/EMIR/MIFID/SFTR
* Reconciliation experience in Regulations is a plus

* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce
* Professional certifications such as the CFA, CPA, or FRM may also be beneficial.
  

  
  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most.
