title: Lead Engineer - Mechanical Drives
description:
**Job Description**

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

**Who will you be working with?**

Our best-in-class Mechanical Drives team maintains deep domain expertise related to Locomotive wheels, axles, gears & gearcases, Off-Highway Vehicle transmission assemblies, bearings, seals, and lubricants. Here you’ll interact with various internal and external customers on a global team of engineers that work together to address real word challenges, create customer specific solutions, and develop innovative & reliable products.

**How will you make a difference?**

The Mechanical Drives Engineer will collaborate with a global cross functional team to lead concept development, detail design, and validation for both Locomotive applications as well as Off-Highway Vehicles used in the Mining Industry.

**What do we want to know about you?**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or Structural Engineering
* Minimum 3.0 GPA
* Minimum 5 years of years of experience in mechanical structures engineering
* Experience with mechanical structures, seals on mobile equipment, in rail and/or mining industries
* What **will your typical day look like?**·Mechanical structure (seals, gearcases, wheels, axles, shafts, gears, castings, bearings, housings) design, analysis, and validation leading detailed design reviews with internal and/or external stakeholders Developing and preparing instructions for assembly methods and constraints monitoring and communicating project status, business issues, and significant developments Fatigue evaluation and life predictions – parent material SN curves, weld evaluation, etc. Support the Sourcing function in development and execution of strategic Sourcing initiatives including vendor qualifications and validation testing. Support factory for equipment builds issue resolution & build quality verification. Provide root cause analysis interfacing with leadership and customer. Execute service productivity projects, evaluating performance versus cost trade-offs. You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary. Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met. Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

**Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:**

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need for accommodation, please let us know.

 **Additional Information**

**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.

The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.

  

**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 10 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Senior Associate
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world. There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career. Your future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise • Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019 implementation and management • VMware ESX experience • Public/private cloud management. Especially migration from onprem to cloud solution Preferred Technical and Professional Experience • Automation experience, especially IaaS (infrastructure as a code) • Vulnerability management • Microsoft Active Directory and federation services  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Salesforce Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the team**  
The Engineering Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
The Expedia team is seeking a highly collaborative Salesforce Engineer to join our team. This is a “wear-many-hats” role responsible for designing and configuring solutions in and around Salesforce, with hands-on development and administration, and technically lead the project.

**In this role you will:**
--------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure Salesforce solutions, services, integrations, and platform components that support Expedia Group products and business operations.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, administrators, analysts, and engineers to translate business requirements into robust Salesforce designs, including low-level design, API and integration design, data models, automation, and platform configuration.
* Lead the implementation of maintainable Salesforce code, declarative capabilities, integrations, automated tests, and tooling that improve reliability, observability, security, data quality, and operational excellence.
* Drive code reviews, design reviews, technical discussions, and solution assessments across Salesforce services and adjacent domains, identifying opportunities to simplify solutions, reduce technical debt, and improve performance, scalability, and quality.
* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Salesforce features and services, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, release management, and continuous improvement.
Work across Salesforce, application, data, cloud, and platform domains as needed, demonstrating familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows; applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products; and safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3+ years with a master’s degree.
* Proven experience owning complex software systems end to end, including system design, API design, data modeling, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce development, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce security concepts, and governor-limit-aware design.
* Experience developing software in at least three programming or query languages, such as Apex, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL/SOQL, Java, or Python.
* Proven experience owning Salesforce features, integrations, or services end-to-end, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, production support, and resolution of operational issues.
* Hands-on proficiency with Salesforce development and configuration capabilities, at least one modern programming or scripting language and its ecosystem, and experience with low-level system design, API and integration design, data modeling, service-oriented architectures, and secure coding practices.
Solid understanding of software engineering and Salesforce fundamentals, including platform architecture, data access and security, identity and access management, automation, distributed systems concepts, integration patterns, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Salesforce certification such as Platform Developer II, Platform Developer I, Salesforce Administrator, or an equivalent specialization.
* Experience with Salesforce Platform Events, Change Data Capture, asynchronous Apex, middleware, or event-driven integrations.
* Experience with observability, service-level indicators and objectives, incident management, root-cause analysis, and operational readiness reviews.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments such as Scrum or Kanban.
* Experience influencing technical direction across teams and communicating architecture or operational recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Experience with data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or related data-platform concepts.  

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Technical Lead – Teamcenter Administrator
description:
**Your Job**

We are seeking an experienced Teamcenter Administrator - Technical Lead to provide technical leadership and operational ownership for the Siemens Teamcenter Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) platform supporting Molex Product Development. In this role, you will ensure platform stability, availability, performance, security, and continuous improvement while driving upgrades, modernization initiatives, and operational excellence across the Teamcenter landscape.

**Our Team**

We are part of the Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) team, responsible for providing application support, administration, and technical services for Molex Product Development. Our team partners closely with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and business teams to deliver reliable solutions that enable innovation, product design, and development across the organization.

**What You Will Do**

* Serve as the Teamcenter Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing technical leadership and guidance for platform strategy, complex issue resolution, and transformation initiatives.
* Lead Teamcenter administration and technical operations across development, test, and production environments to ensure a stable and reliable user experience.
* Drive Teamcenter upgrades, deployments, and platform enhancements that improve performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with cloud, infrastructure, database, security, and application teams to strengthen platform reliability and resolve cross-functional technical challenges.
* Advance monitoring, automation, and observability capabilities to enhance platform health, availability, and proactive issue detection.
* Support Teamcenter integrations and connected engineering applications to enable seamless business processes and user productivity.
* Contribute to the PLM technology roadmap by identifying opportunities for modernization, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor and develop Teamcenter administrators and support teams through knowledge sharing, technical coaching, and best-practice guidance.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience administering Siemens Teamcenter.
* 5+ years of experience supporting Teamcenter integrations with NX, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, T4S, or similar enterprise applications.
* 2+ years of experience in database administration, systems analysis, or IT management.
* 2+ years of experience supporting AWS infrastructure and cloud-hosted applications.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Advanced experience with Siemens Teamcenter administration and architecture.
* Expertise with Active Workspace, BMIDE, RAC, Workflow, and Teamcenter integrations.
* Experience supporting NX/CAD and ECAD integrations.
* Knowledge of Teamcenter database administration, performance tuning, and optimization.
* AWS cloud architecture, migration, and modernization experience.
* Experience with Windows infrastructure, Active Directory, and Single Sign-On (SSO).
* Hands-on experience with Teamcenter upgrades, data migrations, and platform transformations.
* Development experience using ITK, SOA, REST APIs, scripting, automation, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience designing and supporting high-availability and disaster recovery solutions.
* Experience leading global PLM implementations and support teams.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. title: Senior Linux Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads.You will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams, and be the person who can say where the time and the capacity are actually going.
* Profile and debug at the system level - kernel, filesystem, memory and I/O behaviour - when workloads are slow, and turn findings into fixes rather than tickets.
* Drive compute efficiency: memory request-versus-usage accuracy, CPU waste from idle and over-provisioned jobs, and the prediction models behind resource requests.
* Build the observability layer for the farm - telemetry pipelines, metrics and dashboards that make capacity, utilisation and job behaviour visible to engineers and to leadership - and own licence monitoring and expiry alerting across the EDA tool estate.
* This is a hands-on technical role. Day-to-day farm operations and live triage are a core part of it, and you will work directly with the heaviest users on their workload behaviour, since most efficiency gains come from a small number of workflows.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in Linux systems administration or infrastructure operations at scale.
* Deep Linux systems and kernel-level expertise - comfortable with perf, eBPF/bpftrace, strace, cgroups, NUMA, memory management, scheduler behaviour and I/O subsystems, and able to use them to find root cause rather than guess at it.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and fixing performance problems on large multi-user compute systems.
* Strong NFS and distributed filesystem troubleshooting: metadata versus data path, client behaviour, mount and latency issues.
* Hands-on experience building observability - time-series metrics, log and telemetry pipelines, and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, or equivalent) - plus strong Python for analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and job resource accounting, and a genuine appetite for operational work. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC background is a plus.

title: Senior Slurm Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute infrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You'll own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.
* Administer, configure and tune Slurm clusters - partitions, QOS, accounting, limits, node states and topology - and operate them alongside an existing LSF estate.
* Automate scheduler operations: node onboarding and draining, configuration management, health checks and routine maintenance.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for job throughput, queue wait times and SLA attainment.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years in compute infrastructure, with hands-on responsibility for batch scheduling.
* Strong practical Slurm experience: configuration, partitions and QOS, accounting via slurmdbd, node management, and troubleshooting real job failures in production.
* Exposure to a second scheduler, LSF preferred, or a clear appetite to pick one up quickly.
* Solid Linux systems administration - filesystems, NFS, networking, process and resource management.
* Working automation skills in Python and shell, and experience with monitoring and dashboarding tools.
* Comfortable carrying a real operational load - you treat production support and escalations as part of the engineering job. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.
